title: Back End Developer
description:
**Backend Developer — Python / FastAPI**

**Experience:**
3+ years

**Employment:**
Full-time

**Primary Stack:**
Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced
**Backend Developer**
with 3+ years of hands-on experience in Python and FastAPI. The ideal candidate should be able to independently understand business requirements, design scalable backend solutions, work closely with frontend developers, and contribute to deployment and cloud infrastructure.

Experience working with
**US financial services, asset management, investment management, portfolio data, or related financial products**
will be highly valuable.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using
  **Python and FastAPI**
  .
* Develop and maintain REST APIs and backend business logic.
* Work extensively with
  **PostgreSQL and SQL**
  , including complex queries, joins, indexing, optimization, transactions, and database design.
* Have practical knowledge of
  **NoSQL databases**
  such as MongoDB or similar technologies.
* Implement caching and performance optimization using
  **Redis or similar caching technologies**
  .
* Design clean, maintainable, and reusable backend architecture.
* Understand business requirements and independently convert them into technical solutions.
* Work closely with
  **React/frontend developers**
  to define API contracts, data structures, validations, and integration requirements.
* Coordinate with frontend, QA, and product teams to deliver features end-to-end.
* Work with
  **AWS services**
  and understand basic cloud architecture, deployment, monitoring, and security practices.
* Understand and work with
  **CI/CD pipelines**
  , Git, automated builds, testing, and deployment processes.
* Troubleshoot production issues, performance problems, API failures, and database issues.
* Write unit/integration tests and maintain good code quality.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to backend architecture and technical decisions.
* Understand and work with financial/asset-management data and business workflows.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Python**

Strong hands-on experience

**FastAPI**

Strong practical experience

**REST APIs**

Strong understanding

**PostgreSQL**

Strong — queries, joins, indexing, optimization

**SQL**

Strong

**NoSQL**

Good understanding

**Redis / Caching**

Good practical understanding

**AWS**

Good working knowledge

**CI/CD**

Basic–Intermediate

**Git**

Strong

**Testing**

Pytest / unit & integration testing

**React**

Basic understanding

**System Design**

Good understanding

**Docker**

Good to have

**Linux**

Good to have

**Business & Domain Skills**

The candidate should be capable of
**understanding business requirements rather than only implementing tickets**
.

Experience with any of the following would be valuable:

* US financial markets
* Asset management
* Investment management
* Portfolio management
* Securities / investments
* Financial reporting
* Investment/portfolio data
* SEC filings and financial data
* BDC / private credit
* Equity and debt instruments
* Financial SaaS products

**What We Expect From the Candidate**

The person should be able to take a requirement such as:

"We need to fetch financial data, process it, store it, expose it through APIs, and make it available to the frontend."

and independently think through:

**Business Requirement → Data Model → API Design → Backend Logic → Database → Caching → Testing → Deployment → Frontend Integration**

They should not require step-by-step instructions for every technical decision.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We're looking for someone who:

* Has
  **3+ years of professional backend development experience**
  .
* Is strong in
  **Python + FastAPI**
  .
* Has strong PostgreSQL/SQL knowledge.
* Understands both relational and NoSQL databases.
* Understands caching and performance optimization.
* Has practical AWS and CI/CD exposure.
* Can independently debug and solve production issues.
* Can communicate effectively with frontend and QA teams.
* Understands React/API integration at a practical level.
* Can understand business requirements and convert them into technical implementation.
* Has experience in
  **US Finance / Asset Management**
  or is capable of learning the domain quickly.
* Takes ownership of features rather than only completing assigned coding tasks.

**Nice to Have**

* Docker / Kubernetes
* AWS EC2, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, Lambda
* Redis
* Celery / background jobs
* Airflow
* Snowflake
* Financial/SEC data experience
* Experience with high-volume financial data
* Microservices architecture
* WebSockets
* Experience working with US-based financial products

title: IT Engineer,Software,Expert
description:
**Overview**
Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
  
  
Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
  
  
We are looking for a highly skilled Senior AEM Developer to join our digital experience team. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and delivery of enterprise-level AEM solutions, working closely with architects, content authors, and business stakeholders to build scalable and high-performing digital experiences.
  
  
**Responsibilities**




+ As an AEM Developer
+ Design and develop AEM components, templates, workflows, and content models using AEM Sites, Assets, and Forms
+ Lead end-to-end AEM implementation projects from requirements through deployment & issue resolution.
+ Integrate AEM with third-party systems via REST APIs, GraphQL, and AEM Content Fragments
+ Architect multi-site, multi-language AEM solutions using Live Copy and Language Copy
+ Optimize AEM performance through Dispatcher configuration, caching strategies, and CDN integration
+ Guide and mentor junior developers; conduct code reviews
+ Ensure adherence to AEM best practices, security standards, and accessibility (WCAG)
+ Dispatcher and CDN configuration

**Required Skills & Experience**
AEM Core
  
  

* Hands-on AEM development experience (CQ5 through AEM 6.x and Cloud)
* Strong expertise in AEM Sites, DAM, Workflows, and MSM (Multi-Site Manager)
* Proficient in Core Components, Editable Templates, and Content Fragment/Experience Fragment
* Hands-on experience with AEM as a Cloud Service (AEMaaCS) — cloud-native author/publish/preview architecture, Cloud Manager CI/CD pipelines, and Rapid Development Environments (RDEs)
* Experience migrating from AEM 6.x (on-premise or Adobe Managed Services) to AEM as a Cloud Service using the Best Practices Analyzer, Repository Modernizer, and Content Transfer Tool
* Working knowledge of AEM Edge Delivery Services and the Universal Editor for document-based authoring and headless/hybrid experiences (Preferred)
* Familiarity with Cloud Service Assets capabilities — Asset Compute microservices, Dynamic Media with OpenAPI, and Assets Essentials (Preferred)
* Awareness of AI-assisted AEM capabilities such as Adobe Sensei and generative content tools within Experience Cloud (Preferred)

Development Stack
  
  

* Strong Java/J2EE background
* Proficiency in HTL, JSP, JavaScript, CSS, jQuery
* Experience with Maven, Git, Jenkins DevOps
* Familiarity with React or Angular for headless/hybrid AEM implementations

Integration & Architecture
  
  

* AEM integration with Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, and Adobe Launch
* Experience with headless CMS architecture using Content Services or GraphQL (Preferred)
* REST/SOAP API integration experience with enterprise platforms
* Exposure to eCommerce integration with Elastic Path — catalog, product pages, cart, and checkout flows within AEM (Preferred)
* Exposure to Elasticsearch integration — indexing AEM content, implementing search APIs, and building search-driven experiences (Preferred)

**Qualifications**

* E. / B.Tech / MCA in Computer Science or related field
* At least 5 years’ experience with custom application development and at least 2 years experience with designing and solutioning, with an overall 8+ years IT experience.

title: Data Platform Architect
description:
**Project Role :**
Data Platform Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Architects the data platform blueprint and implements the design, encompassing the relevant data platform components. Collaborates with the Integration Architects and Data Architects to ensure cohesive integration between systems and data models.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Snowflake Data Warehouse
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
AI Agents & Workflow Integration
  
  
**Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
**Role Summary / Description**
AI Powered Tech Talent
  
  
As a Senior Engineer in AI Infrastructure Architecture for Snowflake, you will own significant portions of the end-to-end architecture and engineering of optimized data and AI infrastructure for production machine learning and AI-enabled applications. You will design scalable warehouses, Snowpark workloads, AI-ready data/feature pipelines, model-enablement patterns, automation and operational controls that align with client standards, SLAs, security, compliance and cost-efficiency expectations. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, platform modernization, regulated data workloads, FinOps and production reliability, while mentoring engineers and partnering with architects to translate business requirements into robust Snowflake-based AI infrastructure solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Own end-to-end architecture and design of optimized Snowflake data and AI infrastructure, including warehouses, Snowpark workloads, secure data architecture, AI-ready feature/data pipelines, model integration and AI application enablement.
  
  
Design and tune scalable Snowflake warehouses, tasks, streams, Snowpark services, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streamlit applications and cloud integrations, including compute sizing, query optimization, governance, access controls and high-throughput data access design.
  
  
Serve as an authoritative AI infrastructure expert on Snowflake, applying deep knowledge of Snowflake Data Cloud capabilities, data/AI application patterns, governance, security and cost levers.
  
  
Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security, compliance, cost and operational complexity.
  
  
Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation actions.
  
  
Drive architecture decision-making by documenting rationale, trade-offs, assumptions and dependencies so decisions are transparent, defensible and aligned with business SLAs and standards.
  
  
Define and maintain AI infrastructure roadmap inputs, capacity planning models, scaling strategies, cost forecasts and performance improvement opportunities.
  
  
Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization.
  
  
Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards.
  
  
Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with business outcomes and translate requirements into actionable architecture standards.
  
  
Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large-scale engineering solutions.
  
  
Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C++, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages.
  
  
Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform-native workflow tooling.
  
  
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced engineering or client delivery environment.
  
  
Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large-scale solutions.
  
  
Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.
  
  
Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns.
  
  
**Required Skills/ Experience**
Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake warehouses, databases, schemas, secure data sharing/access controls, Snowpark, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streams/Tasks, Streamlit and cloud ecosystem integrations.
  
  
Experience architecting scalable data and feature pipelines, AI application integrations, model-enablement patterns, governance, query/warehouse optimization and secure data access.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python, dbt/Terraform, CI/CD, DataOps, MLOps/AI enablement patterns, observability and incident response practices.
  
  
Ability to optimize Snowflake AI infrastructure for performance, cost, scalability, security, reliability and compliance.
  
  
Experience producing architecture decision records, reference implementations, standards, runbooks and reusable platform patterns.
  
  
Good to Have Skills
  
  
Snowflake certifications such as SnowPro Advanced Architect, SnowPro Advanced Data Engineer or related AI/data platform credentials.
  
  
Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail/e-commerce, telecom, manufacturing, energy or public sector environments where data/AI platforms must meet compliance, security, reliability and cost-control requirements.
  
  
Exposure to Snowpark, Cortex/AI features, vector search, retrieval pipelines, feature engineering, model enablement and AI application architecture.
  
  
Knowledge of Snowflake governance, secure data sharing, FinOps, infrastructure partner/vendor collaboration and production support operating models.

title: TC - CS - IAM - Saviynt - Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- Saviynt Staff**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Ability to architect IGA solutions using Saviynt
* Ability to drive IGA projects including project management, team management, client management.
* Should have experience in implementing at least one complete IAM SDLC engagements projects. This must include activities such as requirements gathering, analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and application support
* Engineer, develop and maintain enterprise IAM solutions using Saviynt IGA tool
* Develop and Build new application Integration, Account and Entitlement Connectors and perform periodic certification reviews in the Saviynt Platform.
* Experience in development phase for Saviynt components - Build Warehouse, Access Request System (ARS), Rule Management, User Provisioning, Access Certification, Identity analytics, Segregation of Duties
* Good knowledge in the configuring of workflows in Saviynt IGA tool. Good knowledge of configuring birthright rules for the user onboarding workflows. Have involved in creation of XML jobs in Saviynt IGA tool.
* Experience in implementation process, built and deployment in Saviynt process.
* Should have good understanding of RDMS and SQL queries.
* Professional IT certifications are a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Manager - Software Development
description:
**Location Details:**
Gurugram, India

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

This is a hybrid position. You’ll divide your time between working remotely from your home and an office, so you should live within commuting distance. Hybrid teams may work in-office as much as a few times a week or as little as once a month or quarter, as decided by leadership. The hiring manager can share more about what hybrid work might look like for this team.

**Join our Team**

Data is the most valuable asset in GoDaddy, and our FORGE team is at the center of building an enriched and valuable ecosystem of AI-based data products and services that drives innovation for our partners and clients, serving as integral platforms for generating revenue and competitive advantages within GoDaddy and globally!

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager who is excited about applying AI to complex data challenges! You'll bring strong experience in Agentic AI, workflow automation, and modern data engineering, while helping shape scalable data platforms and AI-powered solutions. This role requires a balance of hands-on technical depth, long-term thinking, and collaboration across teams to drive adoption of data and AI capabilities. If you enjoy solving ambiguous problems, working with large-scale data systems, and building technology that has real business outcomes, we'd love to hear from you!

**What you'll get to do...**

* Lead, coach, grow, and retain a multidisciplinary team of AI and Data Engineers, providing technical leadership and people management across AI/ML, agentic systems, and platform development
* Drive the design, delivery, scalability, reliability, and operational readiness of agent-based capabilities, ensuring high-quality production deployments and business value without compromising engineering standards
* Conduct architecture, design, and code reviews to ensure compliance with established standards, encouraged quality, and guidelines for model operationalisation and agentic architectures
* Operate effectively in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments by demonstrating quantitative analysis, business judgment, and agile engineering practices to make informed decisions
* Partner closely with Product, Business Analysis, Data Science, Security, Privacy, Legal, and peer teams in the US region to understand data challenges and deliver scalable, compliant solutions aligned with GoDaddy security and privacy policies

**Your experience should include...**

* 10+ years of experience in data architecture and building data ecosystems, including 5+ years developing big data solutions and deep expertise in optimising distributed computing systems
* 2+ years of strong experience in Agentic AI development, building and deploying autonomous agents across complex data ecosystems, with expertise in data modelling, metadata management, and data quality
* 5+ years of experience leading, managing, and developing diverse, highly motivated engineering teams
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and multitasking skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with both business and technical stakeholders while balancing competing priorities
* Demonstrated ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where continuous innovation is occurring

**You might also have...**

* A Bachelor’s degree in CS or related technical field
* Proficient in Python, Scala, and Java, with strong experience building Agentic AI systems, including autonomous workflows, agent harnesses, memory management, and orchestration frameworks
* Strong understanding of the modern AI stack, including LLM architectures, frontier and open-source models, prompt engineering, token economy, embeddings, and RAG patterns
* Strong experience developing big data solutions using Apache Spark, EMR, and Databricks for batch and stream processing, with a proven track record of delivering end-to-end analytics solutions on AWS (S3, Athena, Kinesis, Redshift, EMR, MWAA, Bedrock)
* Good knowledge of standard machine learning techniques, including Regression, Classification, Anomaly Detection, and Forecasting, using Spark, Python, and related ML libraries

*We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.*

**We've got your back...**
We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), bonus/incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in our employee stock purchase plan, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. GoDaddy’s benefits vary based on individual role and location and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process.

**About us...**
GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit
About Us
.

At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report which can be found on our
Diversity Careers page
.

We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups (
Culture
). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way.

*GoDaddy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. GoDaddy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements.*
*Refer to our full*
*EEO policy.*

Our recruiting team is available to assist you in completing your application. If they could be helpful, please reach out to myrecruiter@godaddy.com.

**GoDaddy doesn’t accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.**

title: Senior IT Pillar Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Overview:**
The JDE Technical Specialist designs, develops, supports and improves technical solutions within JD Edwards EnterpriseOne. The role delivers reliable applications, reports, batch processes, integrations, orchestrations and data solutions while protecting production stability, security and auditability. Working closely with JDE functional consultants, business teams, CNC administrators, database specialists and external partners, the specialist converts functional requirements into maintainable technical solutions and provides advanced production support.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, unit test, deploy and support JD Edwards EnterpriseOne custom applications, reports, batch applications, business functions and integrations.
* Work with functional consultants and business stakeholders to review requirements, identify standard capabilities, estimate effort and produce technical designs.
* Develop and maintain objects using the JDE EnterpriseOne toolset, including Object Management Workbench, FDA, RDA, NER, business functions, data structures, tables, views and processing options.
* Build and support integrations using Orchestrator, REST or SOAP services, Business Services, EDI, flat files, database interfaces, middleware and scheduled jobs as applicable.
* Investigate complex production incidents involving application logic, batch processing, data integrity, interfaces, performance or environment-specific behavior.
* Perform root-cause analysis and deliver sustainable corrective actions rather than repeated data fixes or manual workarounds.
* Create technical specifications, object inventories, deployment instructions, rollback plans, unit-test evidence, support documentation and knowledge articles.
* Follow Object Management Workbench, package, promotion and change-management standards across development, test and production environments.
* Partner with CNC and infrastructure teams on package builds, deployments, server processes, logs, kernels, environment issues, tools releases and performance diagnostics.
* Analyze JDE tables and transaction relationships using SQL while following approved access, privacy and production-data controls.
* Review custom code for quality, security, performance, reusability and upgrade compatibility; reduce unnecessary customization where a standard option is viable.
* Support upgrades, tools releases, platform or cloud migrations, environment refreshes, disaster-recovery exercises and cutover activities.
* Monitor recurring failures and technical debt; recommend automation, observability, simplification and modernization opportunities.
* Mentor developers and support analysts, conduct peer reviews and improve shared technical knowledge across the support team.
* Liase with other support leads to troubleshoot integration issues including Boomi Cloud support team and external vendors.
* Oversee the resolution of incidents related to JDE/One World applications, ensuring timely response, escalation, and resolution according to established SLAs / KPIs.
* Lead the change management efforts, including training and communication plans, to ensure smooth adoption of new processes and features.
* Participate and contribute to Audit requirements.

**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications and Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 8+ years of hands-on JD Edwards EnterpriseOne technical development and support experience.
* Strong working knowledge of EnterpriseOne development tools and object types, including OMW, FDA, RDA, NER, business functions, data structures, tables, views, versions and processing options.
* Exposure with JDE on OCI , Windows, Oracle Database environments..
* Experience developing or supporting interfaces, batch applications, reports and custom applications in a production ERP environment.
* Experience with JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Applications 9.2 and current EnterpriseOne Tools releases.
* Hands-on exposure to JDE Orchestrator, AIS, REST services, notifications, form extensions or other extensibility capabilities.
* Experience with Java, C, C++, JavaScript, XML, JSON, web services, SFTP, middleware or enterprise scheduling tools.
* Understanding of CNC concepts, package builds, path codes, environments, security and deployment architecture.
* Knowledge of JDE Financial, Supply Chain, Manufacturing or Project modules and their cross-module data flows.
* Experience in a global, multi-company, project-driven or engineering and construction environment.
* Proficiency with SQL and relational database concepts, including safe analysis of JDE data structures and transactional relationships.
* Experience with DevOps practices, automated testing, monitoring, code-quality controls or CI/CD-adjacent processes for ERP development.
* Experience with software-development lifecycle practices, source/object control, peer review, unit testing, defect resolution and controlled deployment.
* Ability to interpret functional specifications and translate them into scalable technical designs.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation and communication skills across functional, technical and business audiences.
* Experience handling high-priority production incidents with clear ownership, status communication and root-cause discipline.

title: Staff Engineer I, TSG Infrastructure
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

**Project Role :**
Data Platform Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Architects the data platform blueprint and implements the design, encompassing the relevant data platform components. Collaborates with the Integration Architects and Data Architects to ensure cohesive integration between systems and data models.

Snowflake Data Warehouse

AI Agents & Workflow Integration

15 years full time education
  
  
**Role Summary / Description**
AI Powered Tech Talent
  
  
As a Senior Engineer in AI Infrastructure Architecture for Snowflake, you will own significant portions of the end-to-end architecture and engineering of optimized data and AI infrastructure for production machine learning and AI-enabled applications. You will design scalable warehouses, Snowpark workloads, AI-ready data/feature pipelines, model-enablement patterns, automation and operational controls that align with client standards, SLAs, security, compliance and cost-efficiency expectations. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, platform modernization, regulated data workloads, FinOps and production reliability, while mentoring engineers and partnering with architects to translate business requirements into robust Snowflake-based AI infrastructure solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Own end-to-end architecture and design of optimized Snowflake data and AI infrastructure, including warehouses, Snowpark workloads, secure data architecture, AI-ready feature/data pipelines, model integration and AI application enablement.
  
  
Design and tune scalable Snowflake warehouses, tasks, streams, Snowpark services, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streamlit applications and cloud integrations, including compute sizing, query optimization, governance, access controls and high-throughput data access design.
  
  
Serve as an authoritative AI infrastructure expert on Snowflake, applying deep knowledge of Snowflake Data Cloud capabilities, data/AI application patterns, governance, security and cost levers.
  
  
Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security, compliance, cost and operational complexity.
  
  
Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation actions.
  
  
Drive architecture decision-making by documenting rationale, trade-offs, assumptions and dependencies so decisions are transparent, defensible and aligned with business SLAs and standards.
  
  
Define and maintain AI infrastructure roadmap inputs, capacity planning models, scaling strategies, cost forecasts and performance improvement opportunities.
  
  
Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization.
  
  
Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards.
  
  
Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with business outcomes and translate requirements into actionable architecture standards.
  
  
Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large-scale engineering solutions.
  
  
Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C++, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages.
  
  
Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform-native workflow tooling.
  
  
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced engineering or client delivery environment.
  
  
Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large-scale solutions.
  
  
Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.
  
  
Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns.
  
  
**Required Skills/ Experience**
Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake warehouses, databases, schemas, secure data sharing/access controls, Snowpark, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streams/Tasks, Streamlit and cloud ecosystem integrations.
  
  
Experience architecting scalable data and feature pipelines, AI application integrations, model-enablement patterns, governance, query/warehouse optimization and secure data access.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python, dbt/Terraform, CI/CD, DataOps, MLOps/AI enablement patterns, observability and incident response practices.
  
  
Ability to optimize Snowflake AI infrastructure for performance, cost, scalability, security, reliability and compliance.
  
  
Experience producing architecture decision records, reference implementations, standards, runbooks and reusable platform patterns.
  
  
Good to Have Skills
  
  
Snowflake certifications such as SnowPro Advanced Architect, SnowPro Advanced Data Engineer or related AI/data platform credentials.
  
  
Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail/e-commerce, telecom, manufacturing, energy or public sector environments where data/AI platforms must meet compliance, security, reliability and cost-control requirements.
  
  
Exposure to Snowpark, Cortex/AI features, vector search, retrieval pipelines, feature engineering, model enablement and AI application architecture.
  
  
Knowledge of Snowflake governance, secure data sharing, FinOps, infrastructure partner/vendor collaboration and production support operating models.

title: Synthetic Data & Teleoperation Engineer (Robotics)
description:
**About Asiacruit**
At Asiacruit, we connect top talent with forward-thinking organizations across industries. Our mission is to help businesses grow through smart, strategic, and people-focused solutions. We support companies by providing high-quality talent for local and global markets.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a
**Synthetic Data & Teleoperation Engineer**
to build simulation environments, synthetic data pipelines, and teleoperation systems that support the development of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and robotic learning.
  
  
You will create realistic virtual environments for diverse security scenarios, develop systems for capturing robotic demonstrations, and manage datasets used to train and evaluate AI models. This role combines robotics simulation, 3D environment development, teleoperation hardware, and data engineering to help bridge the gap between simulated training and real-world robotic applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build synthetic data generation pipelines using NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Omniverse for diverse scenarios, including night vision, perimeter breaches, and adverse weather conditions.
* Develop and maintain simulation environments that support robotic perception, planning, and manipulation tasks.
* Design, configure, and maintain VR-based teleoperation systems and hardware setups to capture high-quality demonstration trajectories for imitation learning.
* Integrate teleoperation interfaces and robotics simulation workflows using OpenXR and related technologies.
* Develop and maintain dataset curation, automated labeling, and data processing pipelines for robotic foundation model training.
* Organize and maintain structured, tokenized repositories of robotic demonstrations for training and evaluation.
* Use tools such as Blender and Unreal Engine to develop and refine realistic 3D environments and simulation assets.
* Evaluate simulation realism and identify visual discrepancies between simulated environments and real-world conditions.
* Benchmark and reduce Sim-to-Real domain gaps to improve the reliability of models trained on synthetic data.
* Collaborate with AI researchers and robotics engineers to support VLA model development, imitation learning, and simulation-based experimentation.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Graphics, or a related field.
* Approximately 2–4 years of relevant experience in robotics simulation, synthetic data generation, teleoperation, 3D environment development, or related areas.
* Proficiency in Python and familiarity with C++.
* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Omniverse, or other robotics simulation platforms.
* Understanding of USD (Universal Scene Description) and simulation asset workflows.
* Experience with VR-based teleoperation, OpenXR, or hardware interfaces is an advantage.
* Familiarity with Blender, Unreal Engine, or other 3D content creation tools.
* Understanding of robotic demonstration collection, imitation learning, or robotics dataset preparation.
* Knowledge of synthetic data generation, automated labeling, domain randomization, or Sim-to-Real evaluation is a plus.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to build practical simulation and data pipelines.

**Why Join?**

* Work at the intersection of robotics simulation, synthetic data, and embodied AI.
* Build virtual environments and teleoperation systems that support real-world robotic learning.
* Contribute to the development of advanced AI systems using simulation-driven training and evaluation.

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams working on robotics, foundation models, and intelligent perception.

title: Back End Engineer
description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.**
**We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**
**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.**
**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**
**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
**Senior FullStack Engineer**
**WPP Open**

* Engineering
* Gurugram

**About the job:**
WPP Open is WPP's AI-enabled marketing operating system, used by brands and agencies around the world. Our engineering teams in India build and run it alongside colleagues in the UK and Europe. As a Senior Engineer you own a component or service, from its design and API to its tests and production health, and you mentor other engineers. The role is backend-heavy, and you also build the React interfaces for the features you deliver. Our interviews are practical and hands-on.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Design, build, test and ship production code every sprint, test-first.
* Own a component or service end to end: its design, OpenAPI contract, data model, Playwright test suite, monitoring and runbook.
* Write design documents and architecture decision records for your component, and review other engineers' code with rigour and care.
* Choose between AWS Lambda and Kubernetes for your workloads, and build and maintain the CI/CD pipeline that ships them.
* Lead triage when your component fails, write post-incident reviews and fix the underlying causes.
* Build production AI features on the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, and maintain your component's Claude Code configuration and MCP server.
* Explain technical trade-offs to product and delivery colleagues, including colleagues in other regions.
* Mentor less experienced engineers and help new joiners become productive quickly.

**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of professional software development in TypeScript and Node.js or Python.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining or launching production software, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
* Experience working in globally distributed teams across time zones, with stakeholders in other regions.
* Backend language and craft. You write idiomatic, strictly typed backend code in TypeScript with Node.js or in Python, with runtime validation at service boundaries using Zod or Pydantic. You understand concurrency in your language well enough to recognise blocking work and profile a misbehaving service, and you know NestJS, Fastify or FastAPI in depth.
* React and frontend. You choose and justify state-management approaches in React, keep rendering fast through memoisation, lazy loading and code splitting, and meet WCAG AA accessibility on the

features you build. You contribute components to the design system and can build interfaces that stream responses from AI services.
  
  

* APIs and data formats. You design REST APIs with OpenAPI and own the contract for your service, including versioning, backwards compatibility, idempotency keys, rate limiting and webhooks. You know when to use JSON and when to use Protocol Buffers, and you check schema compatibility automatically in your pipeline.
* Data. You design PostgreSQL schemas and change them without downtime, tune slow queries and understand transaction isolation. You model data well in both DynamoDB and MongoDB, use Redis for caching, and choose the right store for each workload with clear reasons.
* Asynchronous systems and reliability. You design producers and consumers on queues such as SQS and BullMQ or Celery, with retries, dead-letter queues and idempotent handlers so that at-least-once delivery is safe. You recognise when these safeguards are needed before anyone asks.
* Cloud and platform. You design services on AWS Lambda, with sensible function boundaries, concurrency settings, dead-letter queues and Step Functions or EventBridge where needed, all defined

as code with AWS CDK or SAM. You operate workloads on Kubernetes, including Helm, autoscaling, rollouts and rollbacks, and you choose between serverless and containers for each workload.
  
  

* Testing and quality. You practise test-driven development and apply it to the design of whole components, not just individual functions. You write integration and contract tests with Testcontainers and

own your component's Playwright test suite, including test data, parallel runs and removing flaky tests.
  
  

* Observability and performance. You instrument services with OpenTelemetry, own the Datadog monitors, alerts and CloudWatch alarms for your component, and lead triage and post-incident reviews

when it fails. You set performance budgets, profile under realistic load, and find memory leaks and blocking work in production.
  
  

* Security and identity. You implement OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect end to end, including the authorisation-code flow with PKCE and client credentials for service-to-service calls. You design role based access control, rotate secrets and keys, and secure your supply chain with dependency scanning and static analysis in the pipeline.
* Architecture and design. You design a service from a short brief, write design documents and architecture decision records that name the trade-offs, and design for backwards compatibility so that

changes do not break the people who depend on your service.
  
  

* Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow and hold others to it in code review. You build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, treat every dependency as something to pin and upgrade on a regular cadence, and write documentation for the people who will read it. AI-first engineering and LLMs. You build production features on the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, using tool calling, structured output and evaluations, and you track token usage and cost. You maintain the Claude Code configuration for your component, including CLAUDE.md, skills and subagents, and have built an MCP server that exposes your service to AI agents.
* Communication, collaboration and initiative. You communicate clearly and concisely, and you explain technical trade-offs to product, design and delivery colleagues in terms they can act on. You understand problems quickly and confirm shared understanding before acting. You collaborate well across locations and time zones, working asynchronously and handing over cleanly. You are proactive: you spot problems before you are asked, propose solutions and improvements of your own, and see them through without waiting for instructions.
* Leadership and behaviours. You review others' code with rigour and care, mentor less experienced engineers, and disagree openly when you need to and then commit fully to the decision. You say "I don't know" when you don't, and you dig in until you do.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* Experience with monorepo tooling such as Nx or Turborepo at scale.
* Experience with Kafka and change data capture.
* Experience with behaviour-driven development using Cucumber.
* Experience with Bigtable.

title: Lead, AI Engineering
description:
*Application submission deadline, 26 October 2026*

**What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on
 


Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list

 
and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**

Bain’s
 


AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team

 

works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into r

obust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

 

**The Impact You’ll Have**

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.

  

As an AI Engineer in AIS, you will build the technical core of these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

**The Role**

The Lead AI Engineer will design, build, and ship generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle — from early experimentation and prototyping through to production deployment — collaborating closely with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with growing influence on technical direction and an opportunity to begin mentoring more junior team members.

  

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

  

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Build and iterate on multi-component AI pipelines, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
  + Embedding generation and optimization
  + Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Implement reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
* Build and contribute to agentic systems, applying sound engineering principles around separation of concerns, memory architecture, and tool integration
* Contribute across the full stack: model experimentation, evaluation design, and production system deployment
* Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
* Support and help build GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  + Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
  + Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  + Hallucination rate and factual consistency
  + Relevance and precision/recall
  + Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  + Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Contribute technical insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and, where relevant, clients
* Share knowledge with peers and support a culture of technical learning around RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**

* 3–5+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience shipping generative AI features or systems end-to-end, from prototyping through production
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical collaborators and stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and data science teams; some experience supporting or informally mentoring peers is a plus
* Solid prompt engineering and context engineering skills; familiarity with conversation design principles
* Working knowledge of evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM applications
* Experience with:
  + RAG architectures (vector-based retrieval; exposure to hybrid or graph-based approaches is a plus)
  + Agentic patterns (tool use, routing, memory management; multi-agent systems experience is a plus)
  + ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
  + AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Familiarity with cost and latency tradeoffs when working with LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Eagerness to grow into a technical leadership role and support junior team members
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

  

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

title: Engineer 3 - Business Systems
description:
The CRM Technologies team builds, scales, and operates Salesforce-based solutions that power MongoDB’s customer lifecycle, from marketing engagement and lead management through sales execution, account management, renewals, reporting, and downstream operational workflows.
  
  
The team partners closely with Marketing, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Customer Success, Data, and Engineering to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable business systems. The team continuously evolves the CRM and marketing technology ecosystem through automation, integrations, data quality improvements, and platform operations.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an Engineer III, Business Systems to design, build, and support the systems and integrations that enable MongoDB’s top-of-funnel and lead-to-revenue processes.
  
  
This individual contributor role will focus on marketing technology, lead lifecycle management, enrichment, campaign operations, account and territory management, activity management, outreach, annual planning, and inbound and outbound integrations. You will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions using Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, integration tools, APIs, and data services.
  
  
You will own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, and production support. You will also contribute to engineering standards, platform governance, data quality, and continuous improvement across the GTM Technology ecosystem.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and support solutions for top-of-funnel and marketing operations processes
* Develop and enhance lead capture, lead conversion, routing, qualification, scoring, and lifecycle management capabilities
* Administer and integrate marketing and enrichment platforms such as FCI, LeanData, Ortoo, and related GTM applications
* Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, data, and downstream business systems
* Support campaign management, campaign attribution, audience segmentation, campaign member management, and marketing performance workflows
* Develop scalable solutions for account management, territory planning, account assignment, ownership changes, and coverage models
* Design and support partner management capabilities, including partner onboarding, partner data management, partner lifecycle workflows, referral and lead registration processes, partner attribution, and partner communications
* Build and enhance partner portal experiences that provide secure access to leads, opportunities, campaign resources, enablement content, deal registration, performance insights, and relevant account information
* Enable activity management and Outreach workflows across marketing, business development, sales, and partner teams
* Design and support inbound integrations that create, enrich, qualify, and route leads and accounts into Salesforce
* Partner with Marketing Operations, Sales Development, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data, and Engineering to understand requirements and identify process gaps
* Contribute to documentation, UAT, regression testing, runbooks, monitoring, and user enablement

**Responsibilities**
Technical Delivery
  
  

* Translate business requirements into scalable marketing technology and Salesforce solutions using declarative configuration, custom development, APIs, and integration platforms.

Marketing Technology Engineering
  
  

* Own and enhance capabilities across:

+ Lead capture, conversion, qualification, and routing
+ Marketing enrichment and data normalization
+ Campaign and campaign member management
+ Account identification, matching, and hierarchy management
+ Territory planning and account assignment
+ Activity and engagement management
+ Outreach and business development workflows
+ Marketing attribution and lifecycle reporting
+ Annual planning and operational planning processes

Integration and System Design
  
  

* Design and support secure, reliable, and observable inbound and outbound integrations across Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, and enterprise platforms.

Data Quality and Governance
  
  

* Establish reliable data flows and controls that improve completeness, accuracy, consistency, deduplication, consent handling, and governance across lead, contact, account, campaign, and activity data.

Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Maintain high standards for modular design, test coverage, documentation, deployment processes, monitoring, CI/CD, and adherence to shared integration and Salesforce engineering patterns.

Platform Optimization
  
  

* Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, integration risks, manual processes, technical debt, and opportunities to simplify the marketing technology architecture.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 6+ years of hands-on Salesforce development or enterprise business systems engineering experience
* Strong experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, Salesforce APIs, and platform automation
* Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as Python and JavaScript, with experience building reusable automation, data transformation, and integration services
* Experience with React or comparable modern front-end frameworks
* Experience with full-stack development, including front-end applications, back-end services, APIs, data models, authentication, testing, deployment, and operational support
* Experience designing and supporting marketing technology, CRM, lead management, or revenue operations solutions
* Experience building and supporting REST or SOAP API integrations and data synchronization processes
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, data quality, and scalable implementation practices
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
* Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certification required

Success Measures
  
  
In 3 Months
  
  
Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s marketing technology and Salesforce architecture, top-of-funnel processes, lead lifecycle, campaign operations, integration landscape, and stakeholder environment.
  
  
In 6 Months
  
  
Deliver meaningful enhancements across lead management, marketing integrations, enrichment, campaign management, routing, account management, or related GTM Technology initiatives. Establish yourself as a dependable technical contributor and trusted partner to Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations.
  
  
In 12 Months
  
  
Become a trusted subject matter expert for marketing technology and top-of-funnel business systems. Drive scalable improvements across lead conversion, enrichment, campaign operations, territory planning, outreach, data quality, and inbound and outbound integrations while influencing engineering standards and platform strategy.

Spec-Driven Development (SDD) and responsible AI-native software development are expected parts of the engineering approach.

* Strong Java and object-oriented design: advanced language concepts, concurrency, patterns, debugging, profiling, performance, and secure coding.
* Experience with Spring/Spring Boot, microservices, REST/SOAP, Hibernate or similar persistence, and data modelling.
* Ability to design distributed systems, APIs, and synchronous/asynchronous integrations; experience with cloud-native delivery, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and GitOps.

title: Senior Engineer - GTM Tech
description:
**About Team**
The IT SaaS Engineering Team is the backbone of MongoDB's go-to-market operations. We build and run the Salesforce platform — with the automation, security, and governance that Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Security, and Compliance rely on daily to manage customer relationships and drive business growth.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
Join us as a Senior Salesforce Engineer and take ownership of the CPQ and CLM systems that power MongoDB's quote-to-contract lifecycle. You'll design and build scalable pricing, quoting, and contract automation solutions end-to-end — from first design conversation to production support — working alongside senior engineers and stakeholders across Sales, Deal Desk, and Legal. This is a role for an engineer who enjoys solving hard technical problems, cares deeply about accuracy and compliance in revenue-critical systems, and wants to bring modern, AI-augmented development practices into how enterprise Q2C solutions get built.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable CPQ configuration (product rules, price rules, bundles, discounting logic) and CLM workflows (clause libraries, approval chains, e-signature integration)
* Partner with Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, and Finance stakeholders to translate quote-to-cash requirements into secure, maintainable technical solutions
* Own delivery across the full solution lifecycle — design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support
* Collaborate with globally distributed engineering teams to deliver reliable, well-governed CPQ/CLM solutions in an Agile environment
* Drive strong engineering practices across code quality, documentation, release management, and platform governance
* Identify opportunities to simplify pricing logic, reduce legacy quote template debt, and strengthen the overall Q2C operating model
* Troubleshoot complex pricing, approval, or contract-generation issues and deliver sustainable, long-term fixes
* Stay current on CPQ/CLM platform capabilities and apply them thoughtfully to improve delivery quality
* Leverage AI-powered engineering tools (GitHub Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce Vibes, Claude Code, Cursor) to improve productivity, code quality, and documentation — with sound judgment on security, privacy, and responsible AI usage.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop, test, document, and deploy high-quality CPQ/CLM solutions aligned with business and compliance needs
* Support enhancements, break/fix issues, and ongoing maintenance across CPQ, CLM, and related integrations (ERP/billing)
* Investigate pricing, contract, and integration issues, working closely with development, operations, Deal Desk, and Legal teams to resolve them
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders on delivery status, technical challenges, and solution trade-offs
* Manage multiple priorities effectively while ensuring high-quality, timely delivery
* Research new CPQ/CLM platform capabilities and engineering approaches to improve the Q2C ecosystem
* Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers and administrators where needed
* Contribute to a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
* 9+ years of experience in Salesforce development and enterprise application engineering, with 3+ years specifically in CPQ and/or CLM implementation
* Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ (product/price rules, quote templates, approval processes) and a CLM platform (Malbek, DocuSign CLM, Conga, or similar)
* Strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), JavaScript, Flows, SOQL, APIs, and platform customization
* Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, governor limits, declarative automation, integration patterns, and scalable solution design
* Experience integrating CPQ/CLM with ERP/billing systems (NetSuite preferred)
* Experience with CI/CD, deployment processes, code refactoring, and performance optimization
* Salesforce Platform Developer II (PD2) certification strongly preferred; Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification a plus; JavaScript Developer, Advanced Administrator, Application Architect, or System Architect certifications also valued
* Working knowledge of AI-powered and agentic development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Salesforce Agentforce Vibes) and the ability to use them effectively to improve productivity and delivery

Success Measures
  
  

* In 3 months, you will: Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s Salesforce ecosystem, business processes, and current implementations by working closely with senior engineers and stakeholders
* In 6 months, you will: Successfully deliver one or more critical Salesforce initiatives and establish yourself as a trusted technical contributor within the Sales Apps team
* In 12 months, you will: Become a go-to engineer for key Salesforce solutions, build strong cross-functional partnerships, and contribute meaningfully to the scalability, quality, and long-term evolution of the CRM platform

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
