title: Principal Engineer
description:
****About Payoneer****
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
  
  
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
  
  
Principal Engineer – Backend
  
  
****About Payoneer****
Payoneer empowers businesses, professionals, and enterprises to participate in the global economy by enabling seamless cross-border payments and financial services. Our technology powers critical financial workflows at global scale, with a strong focus on reliability, security, scalability, and innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a Principal Engineer – Backend to provide technical leadership across Payoneer's backend engineering organization and help shape the next generation of our distributed financial systems.
  
  
This is a high-impact individual contributor role for an engineer who combines deep expertise in distributed systems and backend architecture with strong product thinking and organizational influence.
  
  
As a Principal Engineer, you will work on some of Payoneer's most complex technical challenges, define architectural direction, drive engineering excellence, and enable multiple teams to build reliable, scalable, and resilient systems.
  
  
The role also requires an AI-first mindset in identifying opportunities to use AI and agentic technologies to improve how we build, operate, and evolve our products and engineering systems. You will also help explore and build systems using emerging protocols and technologies such as MCP (Model Context Protocol).
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Define and drive the technical and architectural vision for large-scale backend systems and distributed platforms.
* Design and build highly scalable, resilient, secure, and fault-tolerant distributed systems supporting Payoneer's global financial infrastructure.
* Solve complex technical problems spanning multiple systems, services, teams, and domains.
* Drive architectural decisions and establish engineering patterns, standards, and best practices across teams.
* Lead the evolution of backend platforms toward greater scalability, reliability, observability, performance, and developer productivity.
* Act as a technical leader and trusted advisor to engineering leadership, product leaders, and other stakeholders.
* Work closely with engineering teams to identify and address systemic technical challenges and technical debt.
* Champion an AI-first approach to software engineering, identifying opportunities to leverage LLMs, AI agents, automation, and intelligent developer tooling across the software development lifecycle.
* Explore, prototype, and drive adoption of emerging AI technologies, including MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent-based architectures, where they can create meaningful business or engineering value.
* Partner with teams across engineering, product, security, infrastructure, data, and other functions to solve complex cross-domain problems.
* Influence technical strategy across multiple engineering teams and organizational boundaries, without relying solely on direct authority.
* Mentor and coach engineering leads, senior engineers, and architects, helping raise the technical bar across the organization.
* Help develop the next generation of technical leaders through architecture reviews, design discussions, technical mentorship, and knowledge sharing.
* Establish and promote practices around engineering excellence, system design, reliability, security, testing, observability, and operational readiness.
* Lead technical initiatives that require coordination across geographically distributed and cross-functional teams.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and continuously evaluate how they can improve Payoneer's engineering capabilities.

****What We're Looking For****

* Extensive experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems and backend platforms.
* Strong expertise in backend engineering, system architecture, APIs, microservices, data-intensive systems, and cloud-native architectures.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts including consistency, availability, fault tolerance, concurrency, distributed transactions, messaging, event-driven architectures, and scalability.
* Proven experience leading architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineering teams or complex technology domains.
* Strong track record of taking ambiguous, complex problems and translating them into scalable technical solutions.
* Experience operating systems at significant scale with strong requirements around availability, performance, security, and reliability.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, observability, production operations, and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience with AI/LLM technologies and a demonstrated interest in building AI-first engineering systems and workflows.
* Familiarity with AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), tool calling, agentic workflows, or similar emerging AI technologies is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence engineering and product decisions across organizational boundaries.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers, tech leads, and technical leaders.
* Strong product mindset and the ability to balance technical excellence with business outcomes.
* Comfortable working in a globally distributed, cross-functional engineering environment.

****What Success Looks Like****
In this role, success means having an impact beyond the systems you directly build.
  
  
**You Will:**

* Shape the architecture and technical direction of critical Payoneer platforms.
* Enable multiple engineering teams to build and operate better distributed systems.
* Raise the technical bar through mentorship, architecture leadership, and engineering practices.
* Help Payoneer adopt an AI-first engineering culture and identify high-value opportunities for AI and agentic technologies.
* Drive successful adoption of emerging technologies such as MCP where appropriate.
* Improve the scalability, reliability, security, and efficiency of our platforms.
* Become a trusted technical partner to engineering, product, and business leadership.

**Why This Role**
The Principal Engineer role provides an opportunity to operate at the intersection of technology, architecture, product, and organizational leadership.
  
  
You will work on complex problems at global scale, influence technology strategy across teams, mentor the next generation of engineering leaders, and help shape how Payoneer builds software in an increasingly AI-first world.
  
  
**The Payoneer Ways of Working**
**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*
****Build Each Other Up****
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.
  
  
*We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.*

**Must have skills required:**
content provenance, eval tooling, Policy engines, LLM or agent system, Docker, AWS, GCP, Azure, Python, FastAPI
  
  
**N/A is Looking for:******
**About The Founders**
We are second-time entrepreneurs and operators behind Momspresso, acquired by Honasa/Mamaearth in 2023, along with leadership experience across companies like Unilever, PepsiCo, Aviva, and WinZO.
  
  
We have worked with 300+ brands across FMCG, BFSI, DTC, healthcare, retail, and other consumer categories.
  
  
**The Role**
We're hiring an AI Platform Engineer to build and own the shared runtime our AI agents run on, and the evals that keep it honest.
  
  
We run AI agents on behalf of brands. Those agents need one gateway to the models, one place prompts get routed, and one gate that checks what is allowed before anything ships. And they need proof they work, because a brand cannot take our word for it.
  
  
Reports to the engineering lead. Individual contributor. Office in Gurugram, Monday to Friday.
  
  
**The Hard Problems**

* Build one agent runtime that new use cases plug into, without forking the code.
* Build evals strong enough to block a bad release, not just report on it.
* Run a policy gate on every generated asset, fast enough to sit in the request path.
* Keep many brands on one platform, where Brand A''s memory never reaches Brand B''s output.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Agent runtime and LLM gateway: Own one reusable platform for agent orchestration, tool execution and prompt routing, with a single path to Anthropic, OpenAI and others (caching, dedup, fallback, retries).
* Evals and release gates: Build the offline and online eval harness, golden datasets, calibrated LLM-as-judge and a CI regression gate that stops a prompt change that drops a score.
* Cost, retrieval and latency: Own inference spend per unit of output, prompt caching, and vector search over brand history (pgvector or similar) wired into the agents.
* Safety and brand isolation: Own the sandboxed policy gate, disclosure metadata and audit log on every asset, prompt-injection defence, four autonomy tiers, a kill switch and one-step rollback.
* Observability and design: Trace every agent step with OpenTelemetry so a wrong output points to the step that caused it, and own high-level and low-level design.

**What We''re Looking For**

* 3–5 years of total experience, with 2+ years in backend engineering. Python, FastAPI in production.
* Shipped an LLM or agent system to production: not a demo, not a notebook.
* Built a platform others build on: SDK, shared service or internal framework with real users.
* Built an eval harness that blocked a bad release. Tell us about the release it blocked.
* Cost or latency work you can quantify. You cut a number and you know how.
* RAG in production. Embeddings, a vector store, chunking choices you can defend.
* Cloud and CI/CD. AWS or GCP, Docker, GitHub Actions or equivalent.
* Distributed systems basics. Caching, queues, idempotency, P99 latency.
* Written design docs. Led at least a small team or a large project end to end.
* Good to have: eval tooling (Braintrust, LangSmith, DeepEval, or your own), policy engines (OPA/Rego, sandboxes), content provenance (C2PA, watermarking, EU AI Act), ad tech or martech, and side projects with agents. We read them.

**Why Join**
We''re not just building software. We''re reshaping how brands understand and scale creativity with AI. You will build the platform every agent runs on, and the measurement that proves it works.
  
  
This is an early role in a company built from the ground up. What you build becomes the foundation others build on.

* Step 1: Click On Apply! And Register or Login on our portal.
* Step 2: Complete the Screening Form & Upload updated Resume
* Step 3: Increase your chances to get shortlisted & meet the client for the Interview!

Our goal is to make hiring reliable, simple, and fast. Our role will be to help all our talents find and apply for relevant contractual onsite opportunities and progress in their career. We will support any grievances or challenges you may face during the engagement.
  
  
(Note: There are many more opportunities apart from this on the portal. Depending on the assessments you clear, you can apply for them as well).
  
  
So, if you are ready for a new challenge, a great work environment, and an opportunity to take your career to the next level, don't hesitate to apply today. We are waiting for you!

description:
**Computer Engineering — AI Data Trainer**
**About The Role**
We're looking for computer engineering experts to help train and improve the next generation of AI models. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs — and your deep technical knowledge is exactly what's needed to make these systems smarter, more accurate, and more reliable.
  
  
You'll stress-test advanced language models on complex hardware and systems topics, expose their failure modes, and help build the ground-truth solutions that shape how AI reasons about computer engineering.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Design Challenging Problems — Create advanced computer engineering scenarios spanning RISC-V/ARM architecture, FPGA development, memory management, hardware-software co-design, embedded systems, and more
* Author Gold-Standard Solutions — Write rigorous, step-by-step technical solutions including assembly code, HDL snippets, and architectural diagrams that serve as benchmarks for AI training
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI-generated code (C/C++, Verilog, VHDL), logic gate designs, and OS kernel implementations for technical accuracy, efficiency, and standards compliance
* Improve AI Reasoning — Identify flaws in AI-generated reasoning — such as race conditions, memory leaks, or timing constraint violations — and provide structured feedback to improve model performance

**Who You Are**

* Pursuing or holding a Master's or PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science (hardware focus), or a closely related field
* Strong foundational knowledge in one or more of: Computer Architecture, Embedded Systems, Digital Logic Design, or Operating Systems
* Able to communicate complex hardware concepts and low-level software logic clearly in writing
* Highly detail-oriented — comfortable working at the level of bit operations, clock cycles, and technical documentation
* No prior AI experience required

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with data annotation, data quality, or AI evaluation workflows
* Proficiency in engineering tools such as MATLAB, ANSYS, or similar platforms
* Familiarity with IoT, networking, distributed systems, or hardware security domains

**Why Join Us**

* Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside top research labs and institutions
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and collaboration with experts worldwide
* Gain rare, firsthand exposure to how advanced LLMs are built and trained
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: Database Analyst
description:
**Company Overview**
We are a technology and data services firm working with US-based real estate investment clients. We are standing up a new data-extraction and management service for a client's acquisitions business — and this role is the anchor hire for that service.
  
  
**Role Overview**
You will sit between the client's databases, software platforms, and acquisitions team, making sure information is accurate, well-structured, and flowing correctly between systems. The client's data lives across deal-management platforms and multiple loan databases; your job is to organize these disparate datasets into clean, reliable, query-ready structures that acquisitions workflows — and potentially new user interfaces — can be built on.
  
  
This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role with direct client exposure. Day-to-day, you will work alongside our finance analyst team.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
SQL and data management — write and optimize SQL to extract, transform, and analyse data across multiple databases and datasets
  
  
Data validation — audit datasets for accuracy and completeness; find and fix discrepancies at the source
  
  
Data flows — map how data moves from one system or platform to another and keep it flowing correctly end to end
  
  
SOPs — document how data is entered, moved, checked, and maintained so processes are repeatable and auditable
  
  
Data governance — establish and maintain standards for how data is structured, managed, and controlled
  
  
Systems and UI — build fluency with the client's software platforms and their front ends; support interface buildouts on top of the organized data
  
  
Acquisitions support — connect data from various platforms and systems to acquisition-related workflows, delivering structured outputs the deal team can act on
  
  
Process improvement — identify opportunities to make in-house data processes more efficient or automated (Python scripting, scheduled jobs)
  
  
**Must-Haves\***
5–8 years in database analyst, data analyst, or database administrator roles — this is not an entry-level position
  
  
Expert SQL: complex joins, data modelling, and query optimization on large relational datasets
  
  
5+ years of hands-on experience with Python and related technologies (pandas, NumPy, or similar) for data manipulation and automation
  
  
Working comfort with financial data — loan, deal, or investment datasets
  
  
Track record of documenting processes and setting data-quality or governance standards
  
  
Strong written and spoken English — this is a client-facing role with direct exposure to US stakeholders
  
  
Self-directed in a fully remote setup, with partial overlap with US business hours for key meetings
  
  
**Nice-to-Haves\***
Real estate or commercial real estate data experience (deal pipelines, loan servicing, property data)
  
  
Familiarity with deal-management platforms (e.g., Dealpath or similar)
  
  
Data warehousing experience (schema design, ETL/ELT)
  
  
Experience supporting dashboards or lightweight UIs built on curated datasets
  
  
**Job Details**
**Location:**
Remote – India
  
  
💼
**Type:**
Full-time | 40 hrs/week
  
  
🎯
**Experience:**
5–8 years
  
  
🕐
**Availability:**
Candidates who can join within 3–4 weeks preferred

title: Co-Founder & CTO
description:
**I'm not looking for someone to build an app. I'm looking for someone to build a company with me.**

I've spent years building Snapzo, made mistakes, learnt from them and understood what it really takes to build a scalable technology business.

Now I'm looking for a technical co-founder who can take complete ownership of technology while I focus on business, growth, partnerships and fundraising.

**What you'll be building:**

* Own Snapzo's technology vision, architecture and product development.
* Lead the development of our mobile applications and backend infrastructure.
* Work with our existing native mobile stack, PHP and Python backend, and make the right technology decisions for the future.
* Build a scalable, secure and reliable platform capable of supporting millions of users.
* Hire, mentor and lead the engineering team as we grow.
* Work directly with me on product strategy, user experience, monetisation and investor discussions.
* Move fast, test assumptions and build around product-market fit rather than unnecessary features.

**Who I'm looking for:**

* 7–12+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering and product development.
* Strong understanding of mobile applications, backend systems, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.
* Someone who has built and shipped real products, not just managed developers.
* Comfortable working with an existing codebase and improving it without rebuilding everything.
* A problem solver who understands business as much as technology.
* Someone who can work with limited resources today while preparing for much bigger opportunities tomorrow.
* Most importantly, someone who thinks like an owner, not an employee.

**One thing you should know.**

Snapzo is at an early stage. This isn't a conventional CTO position with a large team, established processes and guaranteed comfort.

There will be unpredictable days, difficult decisions and moments when we'll have to figure things out ourselves.

I'm looking for someone who can see what Snapzo could become over the next 5–10 years and is willing to put in the work to get there.

**This is a co-founder opportunity with an equity-led structure, subject to mutual agreement.**
We'll discuss ownership, commitment and long-term alignment transparently.

I don't expect you to know everything.

But I do expect you to take responsibility for finding the answers.

**I've already taken my bet on Snapzo. Now I'm looking for someone who wants to build it alongside me.**

If that sounds like you, don't send me just your CV. Tell me what you've built and why you want to build Snapzo.

**Kush Chauhan | Born at 41.**

**kush@snapzo.in**

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About Atlys**

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers. Atlys is changing that.

We're building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.

**The Role**

We're looking for a DevSecOps Engineer to own the foundations that keep Atlys fast, reliable and secure.

Not someone who simply keeps servers running or closes tickets from a scanner. We're looking for someone who treats infrastructure and security as products: who designs systems that are secure by default, automates away toil, and gives every engineer a paved road to ship safely.

Few companies handle data as sensitive as ours. Passports, financial documents, photographs and identity records flow every day between travellers, partners and government systems across 127 countries. You'll own the cloud infrastructure, security posture and reliability of the platform that processes it, and make sure it scales as we grow.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just ask how to pass the next audit, but how to build systems that are fundamentally hard to break.

**The Job**

* **Own our cloud infrastructure.**
  Build and run scalable AWS/GCP infrastructure with Kubernetes and make deployments repeatable and fast.
* **Data security.**
  Design access controls, audit logging across internal tooling and cloud infrastructure for PIIs like passports and financial documents, in line with compliance and data security
* **Secure the supply chain.**
  Add SAST, DAST and dependency and container scanning to CI/CD, run vulnerability management and pen tests
* **Vulnerability Discovery:**
  Find, validate and fix security gaps - business logic flaws, authorization issues, authentication bypasses, injection vulnerabilities

**The Ideal Candidate**

You'll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 4–6 years of experience in infrastructure, DevOps, SRE or security engineering roles, ideally at a fast-growing product company handling sensitive or regulated data.
* Have deep hands-on experience with any public cloud, Linux, networking, Docker and Kubernetes
* Have a strong grounding in security fundamentals including but not limited to OWASP Top 10 and cloud security best practices and have applied them in production, not just on paper.
* You can own security gaps in application layer and can validate and fix them yourself across the tech stack
* Take ownership end to end. You make pragmatic trade-offs between security, speed and developer experience. You explain risk clearly and bring engineers along rather than acting as a gatekeeper.
* Prior web/backend development experience is nice to have.

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.

**What you can expect**

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here's what you can expect:

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you'll probably thrive here. If it doesn't, it's better to know that upfront.

**Come build the intelligence layer for global travel**

description:
**About Agoda**

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

**About our Team**
At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds
**high-scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems**
that power a global travel platform serving
**millions of users daily**
. We own mission-critical domains across
**inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms**
.

Our systems run with
**high availability, low latency, and zero-downtime expectations**
, powered by modern technologies such as
**Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike**
, along with strong foundations in
**CI/CD, automation, and observability**
.

We ship fast—often
**dozens of releases a day**
—and design systems that are
**resilient, self-healing, and built to scale globally**
.

**The Opportunity**
As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end-to-end — from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands-on coding, system design, and technical ownership — accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams.

**What You will Do**

* Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
* Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end-to-end, within your service or team
* Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
* Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
* Optimize high-throughput, low-latency systems
* Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
* Make independent architectural and technical trade-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
* Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team
* Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context
* Stay hands-on with coding and system design
* Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
* Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow-through improvements

**What We’re Looking For**

*Technical*

* 8–12 years of backend engineering experience
* Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
* Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs & system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
* Strong coding and problem-solving ability

*Beyond the technical bar:*

* A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks — initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
* Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
* Experience communicating trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
* Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help

Nice to Have

* Experience building large-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
* Exposure to event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)
* Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

The GTMTech team is focused on high-impact, large-scale technology programs, such as Quote-to-Cash. Our mission is to enhance company efficiency, boost profitability, and enable data-driven decision-making by streamlining systems, optimizing processes, and minimizing manual, low-value work through automation and AI.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the end-to-end architecture, design, and implementation of Workato-based integrations and APIs across GTM systems (e.g., Salesforce, NetSuite, HRIS, Google Workspace) with a focus on scalability, reliability, and security
* Define and evolve integration standards, patterns, and best practices, including canonical integration patterns, error-handling strategies, observability, and operational runbooks
* Design and review complex, event-driven integration workflows leveraging technologies such as Kafka or equivalent messaging platforms, ensuring robust handling of topics, producers/consumers, durability, and retry mechanisms
* Drive API-first and MCP-native design for GTM integrations, leveraging RESTful APIs alongside MCP-based interfaces and AI-driven services, including robust authentication and authorization (OAuth2, JWT), versioning, lifecycle management, and integration with API management platforms such as Apigee or similar
* Translate ambiguous, cross-functional business requirements into well-structured technical designs, evaluating multiple solution approaches and recommending the best fit for scalability, extensibility, and long-term maintainability.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other integration engineers—coaching on Workato concepts (callable recipes, event streams, task optimization), API design, and integration patterns, and performing design and code reviews
* Partner closely with GTM, Finance, Data, and Security teams to align integration designs with data governance, compliance, and audit requirements, including CI/CD practices and environment strategies for Workato and associated services
* Establish and enforce non-functional requirements (NFRs) for integrations (performance, resiliency, observability, security), and ensure they are met through design, testing, and monitoring
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues spanning multiple systems and environments by performing deep root-cause analysis and driving long-term corrective actions in partnership with system owners
* Conduct POCs to validate technology or pattern choices (e.g., new Workato features, API capabilities, event streaming approaches) and guide the team on when and how to adopt them
* Participate in and help mature the on-call and support rotation for integrations, ensuring robust incident response, escalation, and communication practices
* Champion and role model MongoDB’s culture principles—Think Big, Make it Happen, Build Together, and Be Intellectually Honest—while driving high standards for technical excellence and operational rigor within GTMTech.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with 10+ years of enterprise integration experience, including significant time in lead/architect roles

title: Supply Chain Solutions Manager
description:
**About Praxas AI**

Every company runs on an ERP. Very few get good decisions out of it. That's where Praxas comes in.

Praxas AI is an AI-native supply chain platform that works as a decision layer on top of the systems a company already has. We pull in scattered data from ERPs, spreadsheets and email, turn it into a single, trusted picture, and use optimization models and AI agents to recommend what to produce, stock, buy and ship. Plans keep re-optimizing as orders, capacity and supply change, and planners stay in control by approving every action.

What we stand for is simple: no rip-and-replace, no multi-year implementations, and no multi-million-dollar planning suites. We're building planning software that's fast to deploy, easy to use and priced for mid-sized companies.

We're starting with production planning for manufacturers, because that's where our first clients feel the most pain. Inventory, sourcing and shipping come next, followed by industries such as CPG, retail, chemicals and logistics. Our first manufacturing partners are already sharing their data and building the product with us. Built in India, for the world.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to embed with our clients and turn their messiest supply chain problems into optimized plans running in production.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a traditional consulting, project management or customer success position. You'll sit with planners and plant heads to understand how the business really runs, formulate the right mathematical model, write production-quality code, connect our platform to their ERP, and stay until the plan is trusted and used every day. You'll move between a factory floor, a solver, an ERP database and a conversation with the owner without losing the thread.

Our clients' data lives in SAP, Tally, custom ERPs, spreadsheets and inboxes, and it's rarely clean. The work is never turnkey. You'll own hard implementation problems through to resolution, and turn what you learn in the field into reusable connectors, models and playbooks that make the next deployment faster.

You'll work directly with the founders and our engineering team. As one of our first hires, you'll help define how Praxas is built, deployed and sold.

**What You Will Do**

Deliver supply chain solutions

• Embed with clients from discovery through go-live, stabilization and handover

• Map each client's production, inventory, sourcing and logistics processes, and the data behind them

• Translate business goals and ambiguous requirements into clear models, milestones and working software

• Own the outcomes clients care about: fewer lost sales, better on-time-in-full delivery, higher inventory turns and working capital released

Model and optimize

• Formulate and solve production planning and scheduling, inventory and safety stock, demand forecasting and supply planning problems

• Use linear and mixed-integer programming, constraint programming and heuristics, with solvers such as Gurobi, CPLEX or OR-Tools

• Build models that re-optimize continuously as orders, capacity and supply change

• Validate models against real client data, test them on past periods, and explain trade-offs clearly to planners

Engineer in the client environment

• Write production-quality code in Python and SQL

• Build and maintain ERP connectors for SAP, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics and custom databases, using APIs, OData and direct SQL

• Build data pipelines and data-quality checks, and reconcile Praxas numbers with the client's own reports

• Deploy and troubleshoot client environments on AWS, working within each client's IT and security controls

• Integrate AI agents into planning workflows, with human approval at every step

Build client capability

• Run workshops, design reviews and hands-on training for planners, purchase teams and plant heads

• Build trust in the system's recommendations so clients act on them every day

• Communicate trade-offs and risks clearly to planners, managers and owners

• Keep scope disciplined and make realistic technical commitments

Make the product better

• Turn recurring client needs into product features, reusable connectors and deployment templates

• Cut implementation time with every deployment

• Write clear documentation: data maps, model specs, runbooks and decision logs

**What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days**

• Build a working knowledge of the Praxas data model, planning engine and deployment setup

• Take one client from data access to a production plan running on their live data, with numbers that match their own reports

• Build or strengthen at least one reusable ERP connector

• Write documentation that makes the next client onboarding faster

**Within 6–12 months**

• Lead several client deployments end to end, from discovery to daily use

• Cut onboarding time from weeks to days

• Show measurable impact at your clients, such as fewer lost sales, lower inventory and better on-time delivery

• Turn field lessons into product features, connectors and playbooks the whole team uses

Who You Are

Required

• 3–8 years building or implementing supply chain planning solutions, at a platform such as o9, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis or SAP IBP, at an implementation partner, or in a similar role

• Exceptional coding ability: you write production-quality Python and SQL, and you're comfortable with APIs, data pipelines and cloud deployment

• Strong operations research and mathematical modelling: linear and mixed-integer programming, scheduling, heuristics, forecasting and inventory theory

• Hands-on experience with AI and machine learning, including building with large language models and AI agents and applying them to planning problems

• Hands-on experience integrating with ERPs such as SAP, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle or custom systems

• Deep understanding of at least two of production planning and scheduling, demand planning, inventory planning, S&OP, procurement and logistics

• Proven client-facing skills: you can run a workshop, gather requirements and explain a model to someone who isn't technical

• Comfortable working on factory floors and travelling to client sites

Nice to have

• Experience in manufacturing, which is extremely beneficial

• A degree in operations research, industrial engineering, computer science or mathematics

• Time at a startup or on an early product team

Compensation and Equity

• Competitive salary, with raises tied to company milestones

• Meaningful equity through ESOPs, vesting over 4 years with a 1-year cliff, so you own part of what you help build

• Early-team ownership: a real say in the product, the way we deploy it and the culture we build

**How to Apply**

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile to admin@praxas.ai with the subject line "Forward Deployed Engineer – Supply Chain". Include a short note on a model or integration you built, and what changed for the client because of it.

title: Principal Architect
description:

We are transforming a global IP intelligence organization from expert-driven workflows into an AI-first, scalable platform architecture. Our mission is to convert complex, knowledge-intensive IP workflows-prior art search, patent landscape analysis, FTO, competitive intelligence-into modular, explainable, enterprise-grade AI systems.

You will work closely with the Director and Head of the Workbench Program in the UK, and partner with the India operations team to understand how the work is done today and translate that into the platform. This is an architecture role with long-term platform ownership and significant technical influence. It is not about maintaining existing systems. The foundations are being laid now, and you will be shaping them hands-on:

* AI-native workflows that reason over long technical documents and cite evidence
* Backend services that orchestrate large analytical workloads across a data platform, and the APIs around them.
* Modern frontend experiences built for reviewing output at scale (React/NodeJS or equivalent) - a near-term critical path for this hire
* Secure, enterprise-grade Azure-based deployments, with Databricks as the current leading platform for the data/AI layer.
* Robust DevOps and MLOps foundations, including model evaluation

You will operate at both strategic and hands-on levels-designing long-term architectural blueprints while actively shaping core systems in their earliest stages. This role is not about maintaining existing systems. It is about laying the foundations for a platform that will define the next decade of the company’s growth.

**Qualifications**

**Technical Strengths**

* 12-15+ years in software engineering, with significant architectural ownership
* Experience building large-scale, distributed, enterprise-grade systems
* Proven, hands-on track record designing and building modern backend AND frontend architectures - frontend/UI depth is essential, not a nice-to-have, for this role
* Strong experience in Azure cloud deployments; hands-on Databricks experience (PySpark, Delta Lake, MLflow) strongly preferred

**Technical Depth**

* Polyglot capability (Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, Node.js or similar)
* Data storage and query design: SQL, Delta / Lakehouse patterns, search indexes
* Structured extraction from long documents; structured-output contracts with LLMs
* Batch inference at scale, and the failure modes of long-context model calls
* Infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipeline design
* APIs and service design
* Desirable: vector databases, semantic search, RAG architectures - though our work leans more on verified structured extraction than on retrieval alone
* Vector databases, Semantic search systems, RAG architectures, Knowledge graphs

**Domain Advantage (Preferred)**

* Experience in IP analytics, patent intelligence, legal tech, or other knowledge-intensive domains
* Exposure to patent data formats, citation networks, IPC/CPC classifications
* Experience building explainable systems in regulated or high-trust environments

title: Forward Deployed Architect, Industry Solutions
description:

To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.
  
  
As a Forward Deployed Architect in our ISV Practice, you will be the technical design lead for engagements with independent software vendors (ISVs). You will work with ISV development leaders, senior engineers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to design how MongoDB integrates with and extends the partner’s product.
  
  
This is an application architecture role, not a database administration or database consulting role. You will ensure that the designs implemented by the team are practical, production-ready, and reusable across future partner engagements.
  
  
Learn more about here!
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What you’ll do at MongoDB
  
  

* Lead technical design for ISV engagements by understanding partner architecture and delivery models, then defining MongoDB data models, access patterns, indexing, and integration approaches for products serving different industries
* Design MongoDB as a supported platform option alongside Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server, including persistence abstractions, feature parity, backend-specific behavior, and certification requirements
* Design coexistence architectures and migration paths, including data flows, synchronization, consistency, application refactoring, dual-run strategies, validation, and controlled cutover
* Lead design reviews, provide technical direction, and review schemas, queries, indexes, MongoDB-related code, and performance against realistic partner workloads
* Design solutions across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or air-gapped on-premises environments

* Stay hands-on by reading partner code and prototyping critical paths, act as the technical escalation point for Forward Deployed Engineers, and share recurring technical gaps and patterns with MongoDB Product and Engineering teams

As an ideal candidate, you will have
  
  

* 8+ years of experience in backend engineering and application architecture, delivering production software products
* Strong application-side MongoDB expertise, including access-pattern-driven data modeling, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, replication, sharding, and sizing
* Application-level experience with at least one major relational database and integrating a new database into a large production codebase, including persistence abstraction, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, transactional boundaries, and incremental rollout
* Experience designing migrations of production workloads between relational databases and MongoDB
* Strong SaaS and product-engineering knowledge, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, backward compatibility, and managed-cloud, Kubernetes-based private-cloud, or self-managed on-premises deployments
* The ability to influence engineers and stakeholders without formal authority through technically sound, practical designs; explain trade-offs clearly; identify risks early; and balance delivery speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
* Willingness to travel regularly to ISV partner locations

As an ideal candidate, you may also have
  
  

* Experience working inside an ISV or product company, including in a forward-deployed, resident-architect, embedded-architect, or similar technical delivery role
* Familiarity with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka or Debezium
* Experience with regulated or data-intensive industries and their security, compliance, and data-governance requirements
* MongoDB certification, MongoDB Atlas experience, or experience with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio

What you will learn
  
  

* Deepen your expertise across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, application development, data modeling, search, vector workloads, and the broader MongoDB ecosystem
* Develop advanced experience in multi-database application architecture, database coexistence, migrations, cloud-native deployment, and the operational considerations of partner products
* Work across ISV products, technology stacks, industries, and deployment environments while building reusable architecture patterns and developing your technical influence and leadership

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Backend Lead Software Engineer (Level 5) | Gurugram based
description:
**About Agoda**

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

**About the Team**

At Agoda, our Backend Engineering organization builds 
**high-scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems**
that power a global travel platform serving
**millions of users daily**
. Our systems span mission-critical domains including
**inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms**
.

We operate with 
**high availability, low latency, and zero-downtime expectations**
, leveraging technologies like
**Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike**
, supported by strong practices in
**CI/CD, automation, and observability,**
and
**engineering excellence.**

We ship fast — with 
**dozens of daily releases**
— and design systems that are
**resilient, scalable, and continuously evolving.**

**The Opportunity**

As a 
**Lead Backend Engineer**
, you will
**own critical systems end-to-end**
, drive technical direction, and lead large initiatives. You will combine
**architecture, execution, and technical leadership**
to build scalable, reliable, and high-quality solutions that power Agoda's global platform. You will
**influence engineering decisions**
beyond your immediate team, mentor engineers, shape development practices, and help raise the organization’s technical bar.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the architecture, design, and development of complex distributed systems at scale.
* Own the technical direction, delivery, and evolution of critical systems and platforms.
* Drive system design, API standards, software architecture, and engineering best practices across teams.
* Lead complex technical initiatives involving multiple services, teams, and stakeholders.
* Make key technical decisions, balancing business priorities with scalability, reliability, and maintainability goals.
* ****Remain an active contributor to production systems through regular coding, code reviews, system design, and technical problem-solving, balancing hands-on execution with leadership responsibilities.****
* Mentor and coach engineers, helping raise technical capability, code quality, and engineering standards.
* Drive continuous improvements in development processes, engineering effectiveness, and agile ways of working.
* Align stakeholders and drive execution across cross-functional teams.
* Lead production stability, incident management, root-cause analysis, and long-term reliability improvements.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve products, platforms, developer productivity, and customer experience

**What We’re Looking For**

* 11+ Years experience building and operating large-scale backend systems in production environments.
* Proven experience delivering complex distributed systems at scale.
* Strong expertise in Java, Scala, Kotlin, or Go.
* Strong software architecture skills with a track record of driving architectural decisions within and across teams.
* Proven experience leading technical initiatives, projects, or engineering teams with end-to-end ownership.
* Recent and ongoing hands-on coding experience in production environments is required.

Deep expertise in:

* Distributed systems and architecture
* API design and microservices
* Performance, scalability, and system reliability
* System design for high-throughput, highly available applications

Nice to Have

* Experience building or owning large-scale platforms across multiple services or domains.
* Experience designing and operating event-driven architectures using technologies such as Kafka.
* Experience with cloud-native architectures on AWS or GCP.Strong understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, automation, and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience driving cross-team technical initiatives, platform modernization, or large-scale migrations.
* Familiarity with high-volume data systems, Spark, Hadoop, or related data platform technologies.
* Experience working in global product organizations with distributed engineering teams.

title: Sr. Backend Engineer – Java/Kotlin | Remote India
description:
🔥 \*\*Senior Backend Engineer | Java | Kotlin | Python | Payments | Remote\*\*
  
  
If you're passionate about Java, Kotlin, Python, distributed systems, and building reliable payment solutions at scale, we'd love to connect!
  
  
📍 \*\*Location:\*\* India
  
🌏 \*\*Work Mode:\*\* 100% Remote
  
💼 \*\*Experience:\*\* 4+ Years

---

• Develop and maintain backend services supporting end-to-end payment flows
  
• Build and enhance payment features, including charges, refunds, disputes, and webhooks
  
• Design and integrate RESTful and GraphQL APIs across microservices
  
• Refactor legacy Java services, reduce technical debt, and improve test coverage
  
• Implement asynchronous processing, message queues, and distributed-system workflows
  
• Write unit, integration, and contract tests to ensure production reliability
  
• Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents in payment and billing systems
  
• Maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines and deliver production-ready code through peer reviews
  
• Collaborate with product managers, partner teams, and engineering stakeholders
  
• Document technical designs, API specifications, knowledge-transfer materials, and runbooks
  
  
---

• 4+ years of hands-on backend software engineering experience
  
• Strong proficiency in \*\*Java\*\* as the primary programming language
  
• Experience with \*\*Kotlin and Python\*\* as complementary skills
  
• \*\*Payments, Fintech, or Billing domain experience (Must-have)\*\*
  
• Hands-on experience building production payment flows, including charges, refunds, disputes, and webhooks
  
• Experience developing RESTful and GraphQL APIs, microservices, and event-driven systems
  
• Strong knowledge of relational databases, \*\*MySQL, and SQL\*\*
  
• Experience with distributed systems, message queues, asynchronous processing, and eventual consistency
  
• Experience writing unit, integration, and contract tests
  
• Hands-on experience with GitLab, code reviews, and GitLab CI/CD pipelines
  
• Experience refactoring legacy services, migrating APIs, and implementing regression testing
  
• Experience resolving production incidents and designing internal APIs for downstream services
  
• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and sprint-based delivery, including Jira
  
• Upper-intermediate English communication skills
  
  
---

• Experience in a large enterprise engineering organization
  
• Familiarity with Spring Boot, Gradle, and service mesh technologies
  
• Knowledge of PCI-DSS compliance, payment security, and financial data handling
  
• Experience with observability tools such as Datadog
  
• Open-source contributions or a portfolio of shipped payment features
  
  
---

1. Email ID
  
2. Total years of backend engineering experience
  
3. Relevant Java, Kotlin, and Python experience
  
4. \*\*Payments / Fintech / Billing domain experience (Must-have)\*\*
  
5. \*\*Production experience with payment flows: charges, refunds, disputes, and webhooks\*\*
  
6. Experience with REST, GraphQL, microservices, and distributed systems
  
7. MySQL, GitLab CI/CD, and automated testing experience
  
8. Current CTC / Expected CTC
  
9. Notice period / Earliest joining date

title: Clinical Systems Analyst
description:
**Clinical Systems Analyst (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
We're looking for experienced Clinical Systems Analysts to bring their healthcare IT knowledge to cutting-edge AI development. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research teams to build smarter, more accurate AI models — and your clinical systems expertise is exactly what we need.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to step beyond traditional healthcare IT support and directly influence how AI understands clinical workflows, medical terminology, and hospital operations.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Evaluate and provide expert feedback on AI-generated content related to clinical systems, healthcare IT workflows, and hospital operations
* Apply your troubleshooting and system optimization knowledge to assess whether AI outputs reflect real-world clinical environments accurately
* Review and critique AI responses involving EHR systems, clinical applications, and healthcare infrastructure
* Identify gaps, inaccuracies, or unrealistic scenarios in AI-generated clinical IT content
* Translate your hands-on clinical systems experience into structured, actionable feedback that improves AI model quality
* Work independently and asynchronously on your own schedule

**Who You Are**

* Experienced in supporting, administering, or optimizing healthcare IT systems such as EHRs, clinical applications, or hospital infrastructure
* Skilled in technical troubleshooting, system testing, and performance optimization within clinical environments
* Comfortable bridging the gap between clinical workflows and technical systems
* Detail-oriented with strong written communication skills
* Self-motivated and able to deliver quality work independently

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality assessment, or AI evaluation workflows
* Familiarity with HL7, FHIR, or interoperability standards
* Background working across multiple healthcare settings or system types

**Why Join Us**

* Work on meaningful AI projects alongside top research labs and teams
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
* Contribute to AI systems that could shape the future of healthcare technology
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: Clinical Business Intelligence Manager
description:
**Clinical Business Intelligence Manager (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
What if your deep expertise in healthcare analytics could directly influence how AI understands and reasons about clinical data? We're looking for an experienced Clinical Business Intelligence Manager to lead analytics work that sits at the intersection of healthcare intelligence and cutting-edge AI development.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for senior professionals who know how to turn complex clinical and operational data into decisions that matter. You'll bring your healthcare BI leadership experience to a team working on some of the most advanced AI projects in the industry.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and mentor a business intelligence team in building dashboards, reports, and analytics that support clinical and operational decision-making
* Design, maintain, and optimize BI infrastructure — including data models, SQL queries, and reporting pipelines — ensuring accuracy, reliability, and performance
* Analyze clinical, operational, and performance data to uncover meaningful trends and surface insights that support leadership decisions
* Translate complex healthcare datasets into clear, trusted outputs that drive improvements in care delivery and organizational efficiency
* Apply your domain expertise to evaluate, quality-check, and improve AI-generated outputs related to clinical analytics and healthcare data reasoning

**Who You Are**

* Experienced in healthcare or clinical analytics, business intelligence, or data management within regulated environments
* Proven track record designing and managing BI systems — including dashboards, reporting pipelines, and data models
* Comfortable working with clinical, operational, and administrative datasets and understanding their real-world implications
* Strong communicator who can translate technical findings into meaningful narratives for both clinical and operational stakeholders
* Self-directed and reliable — you deliver quality work independently without hand-holding

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality assurance, or evaluation systems
* Familiarity with AI tools, LLM outputs, or AI training workflows
* Background in health informatics, population health, or value-based care analytics
* Experience with tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar BI platforms

**Why Join Us**

* Work alongside world-leading AI research labs on genuinely cutting-edge projects
* Fully remote and flexible — structure your work around your life, not the other way around
* Freelance autonomy with the substance of meaningful, high-impact work
* Gain direct exposure to advanced large language models and how they're trained and evaluated
* Contribute clinical intelligence expertise to AI systems that will shape how healthcare data is understood at scale
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Product Engineer (App and Platforms)
description:
**Job Description**
This is a delivery-focused role rather than a purely supervisory one: you will carry out the majority of the day-to-day design, development, and implementation work directly. You will be Ansh's primary technical owner of our app and website, working closely with our Analytics Engineer to ensure data flows cleanly from the app into our dashboards, with the M& E and program teams to understand their requirements, and with the C-suite to ensure our technology and roadmap keep pace with our growth. Our tech team is small, so this role calls for a startup mentality and the initiative to step outside a predefined job description when something needs doing, rather than waiting to be asked. The candidate will have responsibilities across the following functions: Develop and improve our field app: - Design and implement new features within our FlutterFlow app, from requirements gathering through to build and delivery, translating input from the M& E and operations teams into working functionality. - Maintain the app's underlying databases, including making manual data updates where required. - Own the full bug and issue-tracking cycle, identifying, prioritising, assigning, and resolving issues that affect app stability, data collection, or care delivery. - Manage version control and releases, testing and publishing new app versions, writing release notes, and notifying the team of changes. - Manage app accounts and access for team members, providing technical support where needed. - Periodically review and improve the app's design, evaluating user interface and user experience to improve usability. Maintain our website, tech systems and accounts: - Maintain and update Ansh's website (built in Wix), including content changes, functionality fixes, and periodic design/UX review. - Manage and maintain integrations with third-party tools (e. g., Trello, Slack, Google Workspace tools, Firebase), keeping systems efficient, up-to-date, and aligned with organisational needs. - Manage accounts and access for the tools and platforms our team relies on day-to-day (e. g. app accounts, website admin access, and other core tools), including onboarding and offboarding team members from a technical standpoint. - Conduct orientation on technology and tools for new team members. - Maintain basic security hygiene across the systems you own: access permissions, password practices, and account recovery. - Ensure backups for FlutterFlow, GitHub, and Firestore are conducted and monitored. - Support with ad-hoc technology projects and transitions, e. g. changing our Google Workspace. - Support with increased AI integration and technology innovation across the organisation. Follow good technical practice: - Apply sound engineering practices to keep our dashboards and app reliable and maintainable as they scale, rather than optimising only for short-term delivery. - Document your work clearly, so that systems and decisions are understood across the organisation rather than held only by you. - Recommend new tools or approaches that would help Ansh's team deliver more effectively. Work closely with the C-suite and program team: - Support the C-suite in building the product roadmap for our app and website, bringing a technical perspective on feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs. - Bring a technical perspective into strategic planning conversations, so Ansh's data and tooling keep pace with its growth ambitions. - Partner with M& E and program leads to prioritise what gets built next, based on what will most improve data quality, decision-making, or field operations. Requirements: - Around 3+ years of relevant experience, including hands-on work developing mobile or low-code app platforms (FlutterFlow, Flutter, or comparable front-end platforms). - Comfortable using AI-assisted coding tools (e. g. Claude Code) as part of a modern development workflow, with the discipline to keep the resulting code maintainable rather than simply expedient. - Comfortable managing accounts, access, and basic security practices across a small set of tools and platforms. - Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate requirements from non-technical colleagues into technical specifications, and to explain technical trade-offs back to them clearly. - High ownership and agency: comfortable being the primary technical owner of these systems in a rapidly growing organisation, and able to resolve blockers independently. - Adaptability: comfortable supporting new technology projects as they arise. - Fluent in English; based in India and comfortable working remotely with a distributed, mission-driven team. - Deep alignment with Ansh's mission, and a serious, evidence-based commitment to impact. Strongly preferred/nice to have: - Direct experience with FlutterFlow specifically. - Experience with website builders such as Wix, Webflow, or similar. - Experience integrating data from custom-built mobile or field applications into analytics tools. - Experience contributing to product prioritisation or roadmap discussions. - Familiarity with data privacy and security considerations for health data. - Fluency in Hindi. Company Summary Globally, 2.4 million children died in the first month of life in 2020 India alone accounted for 22% of these newborn deaths. The leading risk factor for mortality among children under five years of age is low birth weight, which is responsible for more than 80% of neonatal deaths. A simple solution holds the potential to significantly reduce these deaths: placing low birth weight infants directly onto the mother's chest for skin-to-skin contact, an intervention known as Kangaroo Care (KC). KC entails not only prolonged and continuous skin-to-skin contact but also exclusive breastfeeding and close monitoring of the infant. KC has proven to effectively reduce mortality and morbidity rates by around 33% (compared to the standard of care using electric incubators) by preventing hypothermia, fighting infections like sepsis, and helping the newborn gain weight through the caregiver's heat. However, adoption barriers for kangaroo care in LMICs, such as India, persist. These include insufficient equipment, a shortage of human resources, and a lack of privacy within healthcare facilities. Many of our target healthcare facilities even lack the infrastructure for conventional standard of care (i. e., electric incubators), further amplifying the potential impact of Kangaroo Care in low-resource settings. Our approach is both direct and cost-effective: repurpose existing hospital spaces to facilitate KC, provide essential equipment like infant weighing scales and cloth binders, and expand capacity by training and hiring health workers (HW) dedicated to teaching and monitoring KC for mothers in the wards. Why Join Us Ansh is committed to equal opportunity. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and strongly encourage applications from people who are underrepresented in this sector. We do not discriminate based on gender, age, disability, caste, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race. We are looking for someone genuinely interested in people and equally comfortable with the process. You will need to hold confidence, tell leadership things they may not want to hear, and keep the administrative backbone of the function running!
  
  
**Required Skills**
['Flutter', 'FlutterFlow']
  
  
Additional Information
