title: Software Development Engineer III
description: What is Hunch?Hunch is a dating app built for follow-through - designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back-and-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.With 2.4M+ daters, 1.47M+ dates planned, and 100% photo-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post-AI world.Link to our fundraising announcementKey Offerings Of HunchOne Drop a Day: A small, hand-picked set of photo-verified profiles arrives daily - chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place - no logistics to manage.Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing - just real, trustworthy connections.Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time - nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.About The RoleWe're on the lookout for a SDE-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We’re looking for immediate joiners. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally.What You'll Do Own backend features end-to-end — product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket. Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy). Own async & event-driven work — queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler.) Ship LLM-backed product features — tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users. Keep production legible — tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences.What You'll Bring 5+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke.Dual-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node + Python — strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice-to-have" role.Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones.Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka — producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates.Service design & delivery — clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.End-to-end ownership — you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product-engineer experience is a huge plus. Engineering hygiene — writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved.Preferred ExperienceML Platform: Serving models behind APIs, vector retrieval (pgvector/FAISS), feature pipelines, and model versioning/rollout. Keeping models alive in production counts double.LLM Application Engineering: Agent loops, tool calling, structured output, and evaluating output quality programmatically. Self-hosted inference (vLLM, GPU serving, cost tuning) is a strong plus.Data at Scale: Redshift/BigQuery/Snowflake, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog).Experimentation: A/B and shadow tests, guardrail metrics, and the discipline to read a flat result honestly.Domain Experience: Consumer social or dating products.What We OfferCompetitive pay along with an annual performance-linked incentive (PLI).Employee benefits like Medical Insurance.Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options).Life at HunchHunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall - getting two interested people into the same room.What We Hire For - The ABCsMost companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work:Authenticity - Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it.Boldness - Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice.Curiosity - The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions — about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know.How We WorkOwnership, not theater - You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping.Flexibility that's real - We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week - show up for the stuff that matters.Move fast, don't burn out - Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours.Small team, big problems - You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product.Backed by Global InvestorsHunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios.Experienced LeadershipHunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) - serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer-tech startup.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - India
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with customer engineering teams to ship production-grade Cursor workflows that measurably improve how they build software.
  
  
You’ll figure out what’s actually slowing a team down, design a practical solution, and own it end-to-end, from first discovery call through launch, iteration, and post-production support. This is not a demo role. You are responsible for systems that work in the real world. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, New Delhi and Mumbai.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Lead discovery with customer engineers to identify the real bottleneck and define clear success metrics
* Design and build Cursor-powered workflows (e.g., large-scale refactors, migrations, PR review loops, incident → fix pipelines, spec → implementation systems)
* Ship a fast first version in days, then harden it into something reliable over weeks with proper rollout plans, monitoring, and iteration based on real usage
* Own production quality: tracing, evals, metrics, debugging model behavior, latency/cost tradeoffs, and failure modes
* Work directly with Staff+/Platform/Eng leaders — going deep in code while also communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results
* Turn what you build into reusable patterns and push improvements back into the core Cursor product

You may be a fit if
  
  

* You thrive in ambiguity and can turn fuzzy problems into clear scopes and shipped systems
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
* You’re comfortable leading discovery conversations and being accountable for customer outcomes
* You build end-to-end - if it needs frontend, backend, infra, or prompt iteration, you’ll own it
* You’ve handled production reliability before (metrics, alerts, safe rollouts, incident response)
* You’re strong in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript and can ramp quickly on new stacks

description:

**unlock the world and make it safer**

title: Technical Lead – Software Engineering
description:
**About ZENNER Aquamet**

At ZENNER Aquamet, we develop modern software solutions that power connected IoT ecosystems and enable secure,

data-driven decision-making. Our engineering teams build scalable web applications, APIs, and cloud-based services that

support customers across utilities, smart infrastructure, and industrial domains. We foster a collaborative environment

where engineers can learn, contribute, and grow through real-world product development.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a highly experienced, technically versatile, and hands-on Technical Lead to drive the design,

development, deployment, and maintenance of enterprise-grade software solutions.

The ideal candidate should possess comprehensive technical expertise across the entire software development lifecycle,

with the ability to independently architect, build, deploy, manage, and optimize complete software ecosystems. The role

requires a strong combination of software engineering, cloud computing, infrastructure management, system

architecture, and technical leadership capabilities.

The candidate must have proven experience working with Internet of Things (IoT) applications and platforms, along with

extensive hands-on expertise in both Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure.

The selected professional will take end-to-end technical ownership of projects, resolve complex engineering challenges,

guide development teams, and ensure the delivery of scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Take complete technical ownership of software projects, covering requirement analysis, technical planning,

solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.

• Independently architect, design, develop, integrate, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications, mobile

applications, APIs, and cloud-based services.

• Design intuitive, responsive, and user-friendly interfaces while ensuring consistent user experience, performance,

and accessibility.

• Develop robust frontend and backend applications, reusable components, scalable services, and secure integration

mechanisms.

• Architect, deploy, configure, secure, and manage production environments on both AWS and Microsoft Azure.

• Design and maintain databases, data processing pipelines, distributed systems, caching mechanisms, and highvolume data handling solutions.

• Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments, infrastructure automation, and application

release processes.

• Ensure system availability, performance, scalability, reliability, observability, and disaster recovery across

production environments.

• Design and implement secure, scalable IoT applications, including device connectivity, telemetry processing, realtime monitoring, and third-party platform integrations.

• Establish software engineering standards, conduct code reviews, implement automated testing, and ensure

application and infrastructure security.

• Independently investigate and resolve complex technical issues involving application performance, databases,

networking, cloud infrastructure, integrations, and production environments.

• Evaluate technology choices, define solution architectures, prepare technical documentation, and recommend

appropriate implementation approaches.

• Lead technical discussions, mentor engineers, coordinate development activities, and collaborate with

management and stakeholders to deliver business requirements.

Required Technical Skills

• Extensive hands-on proficiency in programming languages and modern application development technologies,

including Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and SQL.

• Strong practical experience with modern frameworks and technologies such as Angular, React, Next.js, Django,

FastAPI, Node.js, or equivalent platforms.

• Experience designing and developing web and mobile applications along with a strong understanding of UI/UX

principles and design tools.

• Expert-level knowledge of both AWS and Microsoft Azure, including cloud networking, compute, storage, identity

management, security, managed databases, serverless computing, container orchestration, monitoring, and

infrastructure architecture.

• Advanced experience with Linux server administration, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub

Actions, Azure DevOps, and automated deployment workflows.

• Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis, with

experience in database design, query optimization, replication, and data processing.

• Extensive understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, message

brokers, asynchronous processing, and third-party integrations.

• Proven experience designing scalable, highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure software solutions, including load

balancing, disaster recovery, and performance optimization.

• Strong experience with production monitoring, centralized logging, observability, incident management, and

troubleshooting using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch, and Azure Monitor.

• Hands-on knowledge of software testing methodologies, automated testing frameworks, API testing, performance

testing, application security, and secure coding practices.

• Mandatory experience with IoT applications and platforms, including device connectivity, telemetry ingestion, IoT

cloud services, and communication protocols such as MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, UDP, LoRaWAN, NB-IoT, etc.

• Strong analytical ability, architectural decision-making, technical documentation, problem-solving, and leadership

skills.

**Eligibility Criteria**

• B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech/M.E., MCA, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology,

Software Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Extensive professional experience in software engineering, including hands-on development, solution architecture,

cloud infrastructure, and technical leadership.

• Proven experience leading complex software projects and independently managing technical responsibilities

throughout the complete software development lifecycle.

• Demonstrated expertise in designing, deploying, operating, and troubleshooting production workloads on both

AWS and Microsoft Azure.

• Prior professional experience working on IoT-based products, platforms, or enterprise IoT integration solutions is

mandatory.

• Proven ability to independently design, develop, deploy, and maintain complete enterprise software solutions.

• Strong technical leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Skills

• AWS and Microsoft Azure certifications in solution architecture, cloud engineering, DevOps, or related

specializations.

• Experience developing IoT solutions for smart metering, utilities, smart infrastructure, industrial systems, or device

management.

• Familiarity with LoRaWAN Network Servers (LNS), IoT gateways, communication protocols, and integration with

external IoT platforms.

• Experience working with multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud environments, large-scale distributed systems, and

enterprise security architectures.

• Knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models, AI-powered applications, and intelligent automation.

• Experience mentoring engineering teams, managing multiple technical initiatives, and providing technical guidance

across the software delivery lifecycle

We have built working relationships which span decades with many of the world’s largest energy and commodity companies. We believe that this is because we put our people first and are passionate about providing our clients with deep technical and industry insights that deliver pragmatic solutions. As we continue to grow domestically and internationally, we become more diverse. This rich diversity fuels our business and enriches our culture

 

**About the role**

 

We are currently growing our ETRM/CTRM Endur practice and are looking for experienced Endur Consultants with expertise in Commodity or Energy markets and Trading and Risk Management System Implementations. You will be part of the team involved in implementation/upgrade/support of Endur, bringing SME knowledge in deal modelling, deal valuations, risk management, scheduling, invoicing, and accounting for commodities and energy. You will ensure successful project delivery, employing consultancy and best practices. 

 

**Key Responsibilities:**

 

* Collaborate with clients and prospects to determine business requirements and processes to be addressed by key areas of the Endur solution, with the ability to identify improvement potential and drive change management.
* Work as part of a team on the functional implementation, encompassing design, configuration, functional testing and support transition to operations of Endur solution.
* Support existing solutions for bug fixes, enhancements and operations.
* Document business requirements, implementation designs, test plans/results, and other deliverables required by the project.
* Follow best practices, documentation standards, and resolution process flow for all deliverables.
* Collaborate with technical teams to create customisations based on specific client needs
* Provide industry and functional advisory as needed.
* Apply appropriate resourcing techniques given project-specific needs, risks, and differences in core project team member skill levels and relevant modules to be delivered in client projects.
* Maintain highly effective communication with client and internal stakeholders and adept in handling business changes and managing stakeholder expectations.
* Provide guidance and training on Endur functionality and general ETRM/CTRM topics.

**Skills**

 

* Endur Modules: Good working knowledge in key modules of Endur and commodity/energy operations with working knowledge of V19 and above.
* Endur Risk Management: Knowledge of Endur risk and valuation functionality including results (MTM, PnL, VAR), and EOD automation (TPM and Services Manager).
* Endur Customisation: Deep knowledge of standard and customisation approaches for implementation of requirements, support for reporting, building complex desktops, APM pages, and pre/post-processing logic.
* Endur Architecture: Understanding of Endur architecture and best implementation practices to optimize its strengths for the client solution.
* Functional Knowledge: Strong functional knowledge and understanding of Gas, Power, Renewables, LNG or Crude and Refined Products.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and stakeholder management.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Multi-tasking and Project Management skills.
* Strong organisational & analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, detailed oriented environment and work independently or in a team.

 

**Required Experience**

 

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Economics, or equivalent experience in a related field
* 4+ years hands-on with Endur as a consultant, business analyst, functional specialist, QA specialist or IT support specialist with working knowledge of V19 and above.
* At least 4+ years of industry work experience.
* Good working understanding of various functional areas and relevant modules of Endur.
* Experience in conducting comprehensive testing and quality assurance activities to validate the functionality, performance, and reliability of Endur solutions.
* Worked as part of a cross-cultural/geographical team including flexibility to support multiple time zones when necessary.
* Worked as part of a project team structure and delivered results with limited guidance.
* Ability to travel to onsite client locations for limited time as per project requirement.

**Preferred Experience**

 

* Subject matter expert or functional consultant in Commodity Trading, Risk or Logistics business areas in large enterprise environments.
* Worked in Front, Middle or Back Office functions with specialty in any of the following: Trading (Derivatives, Physical), Risk (Market, Credit, Operational, Compliance), Logistics (Pipeline, Vessel, Nomination) or Settlements (AR/AP Process, Invoice Management).
* Experience with Endur gMotion or cMotion modules would be advantageous.

**What to expect as a capSpire consultant**

 

As part of a capSpire team, you’ll experience the full project life-cycle and be part of a dynamic team in which diversity, camaraderie and professional excellence are celebrated. We like to have fun as a team, encourage knowledge sharing and continuous learning and take pride in delivering the best possible outcomes for our clients. 

 

If you think you have the necessary skills and experience to excel as a capSpire Consultant we are keen to speak with you.

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and participate as an independent contributor with little supervision

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Development Lead to join our dynamic team. * Architect, build, and operate integrations between Salesforce and external enterprise platforms using Data Cloud, APIs, middleware, and data pipelines, including real-time + batch patterns, strong error handling/retries, monitoring/alerting, and data reconciliation.

**Technical Expertise**

* Ensure the scalability and maintainability of Salesforce solutions.
* Stay updated with the latest Salesforce releases and features and recommend improvements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to Salesforce implementations.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science information technology, or a related field.
* At least 12 years of technology experience with a minimum of 5 years of experience in Salesforce development.
* Proven experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, particularly in Case Management, Data Cloud, Agentforce, etc.
* Experience with telephony integrations and CRM Analytics is highly desirable.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce automation tools (Visualforce where needed).
* In-depth understanding of Salesforce configuration, security, data model and workflows.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce Governor limits and performance optimization techniques.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
* Hands-on knowledge of Salesforce CI/CD, including release governance, and orchestration approaches.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I & II.
* Salesforce Application or System Architect certifications.
* Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant.
* Salesforce Certified Service Cloud Consultant.
* Salesforce Einstein Analytics and Discovery Consultant (preferred).

title: Software Development Engineer 1
description:
**Company Description**

NikahForever is India’s most trusted Muslim Matrimony platform, dedicated to making marriages simple and accessible. With
**65,000+ success storie**
s and
**over 2 Million+ members**
, we are committed to fostering strong connections and building a better community. Our AI-based algorithm ensures seamless profile searches and connections, transforming the way people approach marriage. Based in India, NikahForever has created a user-friendly platform where finding your life partner happens in just three steps: Register, Search, and Connect.

**About the Role**

We're looking for an engineer who can
**think independently, solve difficult problems, and turn ideas into reliable production software.**

You won't always get a detailed specification or a step-by-step implementation plan. You'll get a problem, its context, and the freedom to figure out how to solve it. You'll learn unfamiliar systems, make practical engineering decisions, build and test solutions, and take ownership of your work from implementation through deployment.

We're AI-native. You'll use AI coding agents and modern engineering tools to accelerate development, explore unfamiliar codebases, debug issues, and automate repetitive work. You'll remain accountable for the correctness, security, and reliability of everything you ship.

We don't hire based on familiarity with a particular programming language, framework, or technology stack.
**We value strong fundamentals, problem-solving ability, learning speed, engineering judgment, and the ability to deliver working software.**

**What You'll Do**

* **Build and ship software:**
  Turn product requirements and business problems into working, reliable software that delivers measurable value.
* **Own features end to end:**
  Understand requirements, explore possible solutions, implement features, write tests, deploy changes, and fix issues after release.
* **Solve engineering problems:**
  Break down ambiguous problems, evaluate trade-offs, reason through edge cases, and develop practical solutions without relying on step-by-step instructions.
* **Work across domains:**
  Contribute to backend systems, APIs, databases, infrastructure, integrations, data-intensive applications, and AI-powered workflows as the problem requires.
* **Navigate unfamiliar systems:**
  Understand existing codebases, investigate how components interact, and adapt to new technologies without treating unfamiliarity as a blocker.
* **Debug and investigate:**
  Reproduce failures, analyze logs and system behavior, identify root causes, and implement fixes that prevent recurring problems.
* **Make sound technical decisions:**
  Consider correctness, performance, reliability, maintainability, security, cost, and implementation complexity when choosing a solution.
* **Use AI-native engineering workflows:**
  Leverage AI coding agents for exploration, implementation, debugging, testing, and refactoring. Review their output critically and verify that solutions work as intended.
* **Automate repetitive work:**
  Identify inefficient manual processes and build tools or automations that improve productivity and reduce operational effort.
* **Collaborate and take ownership:**
  Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and technical problem-solving. Communicate blockers early and incorporate feedback constructively.
* **Continuously improve:**
  Learn from production issues, measure the impact of your work, and improve the quality and reliability of the systems you build.

**Examples of Problems You'll Tackle**

* Build a new product capability from an ambiguous requirement, making appropriate implementation and design decisions along the way.
* Investigate a slow or unreliable service, identify its bottlenecks, and improve its performance and resilience.
* Design a reliable workflow for processing tasks asynchronously, handling failures, and preventing data inconsistencies.
* Build an AI-powered workflow that uses external tools and APIs to automate a multi-step business process.
* Investigate a production failure in an unfamiliar codebase, identify the root cause, and ship a thoroughly tested fix.
* Develop an internal tool that removes repetitive manual work and measure the resulting improvement in efficiency.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must Have**

* Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to reason systematically about unfamiliar problems.
* A solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, computational complexity, and essential software design principles.
* The ability to write clear, maintainable, and testable code, regardless of the programming language or technology used.
* A practical understanding of how software components interact, including APIs, databases, networking, and operating systems.
* The ability to break down complex tasks into smaller, verifiable steps and make progress without constant supervision.
* Comfort navigating unfamiliar codebases, learning new technologies, and adapting to different technical environments.
* A disciplined approach to debugging, testing, handling edge cases, and investigating the root causes of failures.
* The judgment to make reasonable technical trade-offs and recognize when a solution is unnecessarily complex or unreliable.
* Practical familiarity with AI coding tools or a demonstrated willingness to adopt them, along with the ability to validate generated code critically.
* Strong ownership, curiosity, attention to detail, and a bias toward finishing and shipping work.
* The ability to communicate technical decisions clearly, ask useful questions, and take feedback constructively.
* Evidence of practical engineering ability through projects, internships, research, open-source contributions, or other work demonstrating problem-solving and implementation skills.

**Strong Plus**

* **B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science (CS), Information Technology (IT), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EE), or a related field, ideally from a strong engineering program.**
* Experience building and deploying software that solves a real problem for actual users.
* Experience diagnosing performance issues, improving reliability, or resolving difficult technical bugs.
* Exposure to production systems, cloud environments, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, or incident investigation.
* Experience working across multiple technical domains or adapting to unfamiliar technology stacks.
* Projects involving AI-powered applications, LLMs, autonomous agents, or workflow automation.
* Practical experience using AI coding agents to accelerate development while maintaining strong quality standards.
* Contributions to products, tools, research, or open-source projects that demonstrate initiative beyond completing tutorials.
* Evidence of independently taking an idea from initial problem discovery to a working, tested solution.

**How You'll Be Evaluated**

* **Engineering and project review:**
  Walk us through something you've built, the problem it solves, your personal contribution, and the decisions you made.
* **Practical problem-solving:**
  Work through an engineering problem that assesses reasoning, implementation, edge cases, and correctness rather than familiarity with a particular technology.
* **Code implementation and debugging:**
  Build or modify a solution in a practical environment, investigate failures, and demonstrate how you test your work.
* **System design and reasoning:**
  Approach an open-ended problem, explain the major components, evaluate trade-offs, and reason about reliability and future growth.
* **AI-assisted engineering exercise:**
  Use an AI agent to explore, build, or debug a solution while demonstrating how you guide, inspect, and verify its work.
* **Ownership and learning discussion:**
  Discuss a difficult problem you've solved, a mistake you've made, how you handled feedback, and how you approach unfamiliar technology.

**Why Join**

* Own meaningful engineering problems and contribute directly to product outcomes.
* Work across different technical domains rather than being restricted to a single technology stack.
* Learn how production systems are designed, built, deployed, monitored, and scaled.
* Use AI coding agents and modern engineering workflows to solve real-world problems.
* Develop strong engineering judgment through practical challenges, code reviews, and production ownership.
* Work in an environment that values initiative, learning speed, technical depth, and measurable impact.

**We value engineering ability over technology-stack familiarity, demonstrated problem-solving over memorized answers, and the ability to learn and deliver over experience with a specific tool.**

**Apply Now!**

title: Product Engineer
description:
**About Chariot**

Chariot is a frontier AI research lab based in Delhi, building foundation models. We're one of the original four teams selected under the IndiaAI Mission to build models from India. We want our models to work as well in Indian languages as the best AI systems work in English.

**The Role**

You'll build and own products powered by Chariot's models, from understanding a user's problem and deciding what to build to shipping it, measuring how it performs, and improving it.

This is a hands-on engineering role across the frontend and backend. You'll work directly with users and researchers, make product and engineering decisions, and take responsibility for both the user experience and the systems behind it. Your ownership continues after launch: understanding whether people are getting value, finding where the product falls short, and deciding what to improve next.

What you'll work on

1. **Understand users and shape the product.**
   Work directly with users to understand their needs, identify problems worth solving, and decide what to build. Scope work into useful increments and make clear choices about what belongs in the first version and what can wait.
2. **Build and ship across the stack.**
   Turn ideas into working products, from interfaces and user flows to APIs and backend services. Own features through implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration.
3. **Measure and improve.**
   Decide what success looks like and instrument products to understand how people use them. Use usage data, feedback, and failure patterns to improve the experience and guide what you build next.
4. **Own the systems behind your products.**
   Build and operate backend services that perform reliably under real load, including APIs, queues, storage, and integrations with model inference. Improve latency, throughput, reliability, and cost as usage grows.
5. **Connect product feedback to model quality.**
   Work with researchers to understand where models succeed or fail in real use. Build evaluation tools and automated checks that measure the quality of model-powered features, catch regressions, and help guide improvements.

What we look for

* **Strong product sense.**
  You can work through an ambiguous user problem, choose what matters, and explain why. You know how to scope a first version, decide what to measure, and use evidence to improve it.
* **Extensive experience building and operating backend systems at scale.**
  You've owned production services under real load, handled failures, and made informed tradeoffs around architecture, performance, reliability, and cost.
* **Full-stack engineering ability.**
  You're comfortable building usable interfaces and the services behind them, and carrying a feature through to production. You pay attention to the details that make a product clear and easy to use.
* **Strong software fundamentals, especially in Python.**
  You write maintainable code, understand distributed systems and data infrastructure, and can investigate problems across the stack.
* **Thoughtful use of AI tools.**
  AI tools are part of how you build. You know how to give them useful context, review their output, and verify correctness. You remain accountable for the code, architecture, and user experience you ship.
* **Ownership beyond launch.**
  You follow through on adoption, quality, and reliability. You're comfortable revisiting decisions and changing course when something isn't working.

Experience with model serving, GPU infrastructure, large-scale data pipelines, ML evaluation, speech systems, or multilingual products is a strong plus.

How to apply

Send us your resume, links to code or products you've built, and a short note on why this role interests you.

* Tell us about a product or feature you owned end to end: how you chose what to build, the scale and engineering challenges involved, and what you learned from users after launch.

.

To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. title: Staff Compiler Performance Engineer
description:
**Falcon**
is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

  

We are looking for a
**Staff Compiler Performance Engineer**
to set the technical direction for Falcon performance. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: Falcon is mature and runs in production at large enterprises. You will decide where the next significant performance gains come from, lead the design of the optimizations that deliver them, and make sure the compiler architecture supports the product roadmap.

  

You will be the senior technical voice on a distributed team of compiler experts and a key partner for runtime, GC and product teams.

**What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)**
  

  
* Define the performance strategy for Falcon: identify the largest opportunities across benchmarks and customer workloads and turn them into a technical roadmap
  
* Lead design of complex, cross cutting optimizations in the optimizer and code generator, and of the interfaces between the compiler, the runtime and the garbage collector
  
* Make architectural decisions on the Falcon optimization pipeline, compile time budget and tiering strategy
  
* Lead enablement of Falcon on new hardware platforms and new Azul products
  
* Mentor senior engineers, review critical designs and code, and set standards for performance methodology and validation
  
* Represent Azul in the LLVM community: drive upstream design discussions and contributions that benefit managed language compilers
  

  
**What You'll Bring (aka Experience, Skills)**
  

  
* 8+ years of professional experience developing optimizing compilers or JIT compilers
  
* Track record of technical leadership: owning the design of major compiler components or optimization frameworks used in production
  
* Expert C++ skills and experience in large, long lived codebases
  
* Deep expertise in compiler optimization and code generation, with a clear view of the tradeoffs between peak performance, compile time, warmup and code size
  
* Expert performance analysis skills down to the microarchitecture level
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Recognized contributions to LLVM or another major compiler: code owner, maintainer or author of significant upstream work
  
* Deep experience with JIT compilers for managed languages: HotSpot C2, Graal, V8, .NET RyuJIT or similar
  
* Experience working closely with runtime and GC teams on speculation, deoptimization and barrier design

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Company Description**

NikahForever is India’s most trusted Community Matrimony platform, focused on making marriages convenient and meaningful. The company is dedicated to building a stronger community by enabling genuine connections and long-term relationships. Since its founding, NikahForever has supported over 75,000 successful stories and attracted more than 4,000,000 members. The platform allows people to find a compatible partner in three simple steps: Register, Search, and Connect. Powered by AI-based algorithms, NikahForever is transforming how individuals approach and experience marriage.

**Location:**
Mohan Estate, New Delhi

**Experience**
: 3 years

**The Role**

We're looking for an engineer who can
**think independently, solve difficult problems, and turn ideas into reliable production software.**

You won't always get a detailed specification or a step-by-step implementation plan. You'll get a problem, its context, and the freedom to figure out how to solve it. You'll learn unfamiliar systems, make practical engineering decisions, build and test solutions, and take ownership of your work from implementation through deployment.

We're AI-native. You'll use AI coding agents and modern engineering tools to accelerate development, explore unfamiliar codebases, debug issues, and automate repetitive work. You'll remain accountable for the correctness, security, and reliability of everything you ship.

We don't hire based on familiarity with a particular programming language, framework, or technology stack.
**We value strong fundamentals, problem-solving ability, learning speed, engineering judgment, and the ability to deliver working software.**

What You'll Do

* **Build and ship software:**
  Turn product requirements and business problems into working, reliable software that delivers measurable value.
* **Own features end to end:**
  Understand requirements, explore possible solutions, implement features, write tests, deploy changes, and fix issues after release.
* **Solve engineering problems:**
  Break down ambiguous problems, evaluate trade-offs, reason through edge cases, and develop practical solutions without relying on step-by-step instructions.
* **Work across domains:**
  Contribute to backend systems, APIs, databases, infrastructure, integrations, data-intensive applications, and AI-powered workflows as the problem requires.
* **Navigate unfamiliar systems:**
  Understand existing codebases, investigate how components interact, and adapt to new technologies without treating unfamiliarity as a blocker.
* **Debug and investigate:**
  Reproduce failures, analyze logs and system behavior, identify root causes, and implement fixes that prevent recurring problems.
* **Make sound technical decisions:**
  Consider correctness, performance, reliability, maintainability, security, cost, and implementation complexity when choosing a solution.
* **Use AI-native engineering workflows:**
  Leverage AI coding agents for exploration, implementation, debugging, testing, and refactoring. Review their output critically and verify that solutions work as intended.
* **Automate repetitive work:**
  Identify inefficient manual processes and build tools or automations that improve productivity and reduce operational effort.
* **Collaborate and take ownership:**
  Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and technical problem-solving. Communicate blockers early and incorporate feedback constructively.
* **Continuously improve:**
  Learn from production issues, measure the impact of your work, and improve the quality and reliability of the systems you build.

Examples of Problems You'll Tackle

* Build a new product capability from an ambiguous requirement, making appropriate implementation and design decisions along the way.
* Investigate a slow or unreliable service, identify its bottlenecks, and improve its performance and resilience.
* Design a reliable workflow for processing tasks asynchronously, handling failures, and preventing data inconsistencies.
* Build an AI-powered workflow that uses external tools and APIs to automate a multi-step business process.
* Investigate a production failure in an unfamiliar codebase, identify the root cause, and ship a thoroughly tested fix.
* Develop an internal tool that removes repetitive manual work and measure the resulting improvement in efficiency.

What We're Looking For

Must Have

* Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to reason systematically about unfamiliar problems.
* A solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, computational complexity, and essential software design principles.
* The ability to write clear, maintainable, and testable code, regardless of the programming language or technology used.
* A practical understanding of how software components interact, including APIs, databases, networking, and operating systems.
* The ability to break down complex tasks into smaller, verifiable steps and make progress without constant supervision.
* Comfort navigating unfamiliar codebases, learning new technologies, and adapting to different technical environments.
* A disciplined approach to debugging, testing, handling edge cases, and investigating the root causes of failures.
* The judgment to make reasonable technical trade-offs and recognize when a solution is unnecessarily complex or unreliable.
* Practical familiarity with AI coding tools or a demonstrated willingness to adopt them, along with the ability to validate generated code critically.
* Strong ownership, curiosity, attention to detail, and a bias toward finishing and shipping work.
* The ability to communicate technical decisions clearly, ask useful questions, and take feedback constructively.
* Evidence of practical engineering ability through projects, internships, research, open-source contributions, or other work demonstrating problem-solving and implementation skills.

Strong Plus

* **B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science (CS), Information Technology (IT), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EE), or a related field, ideally from a strong engineering program.**
* Experience building and deploying software that solves a real problem for actual users.
* Experience diagnosing performance issues, improving reliability, or resolving difficult technical bugs.
* Exposure to production systems, cloud environments, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, or incident investigation.
* Experience working across multiple technical domains or adapting to unfamiliar technology stacks.
* Projects involving AI-powered applications, LLMs, autonomous agents, or workflow automation.
* Practical experience using AI coding agents to accelerate development while maintaining strong quality standards.
* Contributions to products, tools, research, or open-source projects that demonstrate initiative beyond completing tutorials.
* Evidence of independently taking an idea from initial problem discovery to a working, tested solution.

How You'll Be Evaluated

* **Engineering and project review:**
  Walk us through something you've built, the problem it solves, your personal contribution, and the decisions you made.
* **Practical problem-solving:**
  Work through an engineering problem that assesses reasoning, implementation, edge cases, and correctness rather than familiarity with a particular technology.
* **Code implementation and debugging:**
  Build or modify a solution in a practical environment, investigate failures, and demonstrate how you test your work.
* **System design and reasoning:**
  Approach an open-ended problem, explain the major components, evaluate trade-offs, and reason about reliability and future growth.
* **AI-assisted engineering exercise:**
  Use an AI agent to explore, build, or debug a solution while demonstrating how you guide, inspect, and verify its work.
* **Ownership and learning discussion:**
  Discuss a difficult problem you've solved, a mistake you've made, how you handled feedback, and how you approach unfamiliar technology.

Why Join

* Own meaningful engineering problems and contribute directly to product outcomes.
* Work across different technical domains rather than being restricted to a single technology stack.
* Learn how production systems are designed, built, deployed, monitored, and scaled.
* Use AI coding agents and modern engineering workflows to solve real-world problems.
* Develop strong engineering judgment through practical challenges, code reviews, and production ownership.
* Work in an environment that values initiative, learning speed, technical depth, and measurable impact.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Role Overview

* Role: Solution & Integration Architect
* Team: Technology
* Reporting to: Global CTO
* Location: Mumbai or Delhi, India
* Employment Type: Full-time
* Experience: Typically 8–12+ years, including at least 3 years in solution architecture or a technical leadership role.

Role Purpose

The Solution & Integration Architect is responsible for designing scalable enterprise solutions and seamless integrations between a digital property decisioning platform and banks’ existing technology systems.

The role acts as a technical bridge between customers, Product, Engineering, IT Operations and leadership, ensuring that business requirements are translated into practical, secure, and buildable technical solutions. It involves hands-on API design, troubleshooting, customer engagement, and end-to-end integration delivery.

Key Responsibilities

1. Solution Architecture

* Lead technical discovery and architecture workshops with banking customers.
* Design solution architectures, application components, data flows, security, and non-functional requirements.
* Maintain architecture documentation, decision records, risks, and dependencies.
* Promote reusable solutions and minimise customer-specific development.

2. API and Integration Design

* Design and document REST APIs, webhooks, callbacks, event-driven integrations, and secure file transfers.
* Develop API specifications using OpenAPI/Swagger, including payloads, validation, error handling, versioning, retries, and idempotency.
* Define authentication, authorisation, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Work with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure API Management, Service Bus, Functions, and App Services.
* Troubleshoot integration issues using logs, API traces, and monitoring tools.

3. Requirements Definition

* Work with Product Managers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and customers to gather requirements.
* Translate business needs into technical specifications, API contracts, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify gaps, edge cases, dependencies, and technical constraints.
* Support backlog refinement, estimation, prioritisation discussions, and solution feasibility assessments.

4. Customer Integration Delivery

* Act as the primary technical contact for bank integration teams and third-party vendors.
* Coordinate connectivity, certificates, whitelisting, environments, and security approvals.
* Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect resolution, go-live, and post-launch support.
* Ensure integrations are properly documented and handed over to Support and IT Operations.

5. Security and Compliance

* Ensure designs meet banking security requirements and enterprise security standards.
* Address data protection, encryption, data residency, audit logging, and retention requirements.
* Support security assessments and compliance reviews involving RBI guidance, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, and CERT-In requirements.

6. Architecture Standards and Continuous Improvement

* Develop reusable architecture patterns, integration templates, and API standards.
* Improve onboarding efficiency across multiple banking customers.
* Capture implementation lessons and collaborate with global architecture, Product, and Engineering teams.

Essential Skills and Experience

* Enterprise solution architecture and integration design, preferably in banking or financial services.
* Strong hands-on experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, JSON, and XML.
* OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, mutual TLS, certificates, and API security.
* Microsoft Azure integration services and API management.
* Event-driven messaging, webhooks, callbacks, batch processing, and SFTP.
* API versioning, retries, timeouts, error handling, and idempotency.
* Experience integrating with loan origination systems, loan management systems, core banking platforms, document management systems, and bank middleware.
* Understanding of banking network security, release governance, SIT, and UAT.
* Experience writing technical specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, problem-solving, and technical troubleshooting skills.

Good-to-Have Skills

* .NET or Java development experience.
* Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Experience working with Indian public sector banks.
* Knowledge of Finacle, TCS BaNCS, Oracle FLEXCUBE, or similar core banking platforms.
* Familiarity with RBI regulations, data protection, ISO 27001, and SOC 2.
* TOGAF or other architecture frameworks.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, and integration monitoring tools.

Key Success Metrics

Performance will be measured by:

* Quality and completeness of solution designs and API specifications.
* Clear, testable requirements with minimal engineering rework.
* Successful integration delivery through SIT, UAT, and production go-live.
* Reduction in integration defects and troubleshooting time.
* Reuse of common APIs, templates, and integration patterns.
* Positive feedback from banking technology and security teams.
* Accurate documentation and effective handover to operational teams.
* Reliable technical commitments aligned with platform capabilities.

description:
**Company Description**
  
When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
  
  
Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
  
  
  
**Job Description**
  
The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
  
  
The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
  
  
This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
  
  
**Core areas of impact include:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:**
  Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:**
  Monitors live AI workloads, owns first-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:**
  Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:**
  Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:**
  Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:**
  Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.

  
  
**Qualifications**
  
**Proven Characteristics for Success**

* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.
* Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.
* Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.
* Surfaces ambiguity in a specification rather than proceeding on assumption.
* Data-driven approach to quality, focused on measurement rather than assertion.
* Disciplined about documentation, with an understanding of why it matters to a small technical team.
* Highly organized with an action-oriented mindset and strong written communication skills.

**Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge / Experience**
**Essential**

* Hands-on experience building with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering and retrieval or knowledge base systems. Self-directed and personal project work is considered.
* Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript, sufficient to read, modify and extend an existing codebase confidently.
* Practical experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication and handling failure conditions in systems outside the developer's control.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data structures.
* Excellent written communication, particularly in documenting technical findings for a mixed audience.
* Legal eligibility for authorized employment within the India region.
* Fluent in verbal and written English.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a workflow automation or orchestration platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Technical exposure to a CRM or sales engagement platform, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience in software testing, quality assurance or the evaluation of AI systems.
* Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or incident diagnosis.
* Experience with knowledge management, content curation or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.
* Experience with conversational or voice AI platforms.
* Knowledge and experience working within the EdTech sector.

**Education**

* Educated to degree level in a technical discipline or equivalent demonstrable experience. Candidates with a portfolio of self-taught, built work are encouraged to apply.

**Tii Elements**

* **Curiosity:**
  Has a growth mindset and leads with questions vs. assumptions. Unleashes creativity and possibility by actively seeking new experiences, information, and knowledge; embraces challenge, takes risks, learns fast and welcomes change.
* **Resourcefulness:**
  Possesses a mindset of abundance and redefines what's possible; creates and advances ways of achieving results in new or difficult situations either by appropriating additional resources, or by doing more with less.
* **Quality Focus:**
  Setting high quality standards for our work and striving for continuous improvement and quality assurance so that our internal & external customers get the best possible outcomes.
* **Self-Awareness & Impact:**
  Shows awareness of the impacts of one's choices, words, decisions and actions on others and on the business. And aligns behaviors with intended outcomes.

  
  
**Additional Information**
  
**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
  
  
Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
  
  
In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. title: Data/Integration Engineer
description:
We’re hiring a hands-on Senior Data Integration Engineer to lead offshore data engineering delivery for a US-based investment management client.

You’ll own ingestion and transformation delivery on Fivetran, Snowflake and dbt, and coordinate MDM, reporting and platform work with the onshore architect and project manager.

**What you’ll do**

• Own offshore data engineering estimates, task allocation, dependencies, progress reporting and delivery commitments

• Build and maintain Fivetran ingestion and approved file/API pipelines; manage incremental loads, schema changes, failed loads and recovery

• Develop Snowflake Bronze, Silver and Gold datasets and modular dbt models with documented dependencies

• Implement source-to-target mappings, reconciliation, incremental processing, historical data handling and dimensional models

• Own pipeline data quality through dbt tests, completeness and freshness checks, and remediation tracking

• Review code and designs across the offshore team and enforce engineering standards

• Coordinate Snowflake and Profisee data flows with the MDM engineer, and trusted reporting datasets with the BI engineer

• Maintain technical metadata, documentation and lineage

• Coordinate integration testing, defect resolution, deployment readiness and production handover

**What you bring**

• 8+ years in data engineering, including 2+ years leading delivery teams

• Strong SQL, Snowflake data engineering, dbt development and Fivetran ingestion

• At least two production data platform implementations delivered, including source reconciliation and operational handover

• dbt models, tests, documentation, incremental strategies, Git workflows and performance tuning

• Working knowledge of MDM integration patterns, data governance controls and Power BI data requirements

• Strong written and verbal communication and ownership of assigned work

**Nice to have:**
 financial services or investment data (customer, account, advisor, sales), Profisee, Dynamics 365 integrations, Python, Azure DevOps, Snowflake or dbt certification, consulting or SI delivery experience.

* Overlap with US Central business hours is required.

title: Software Development Engineer -1
description:
**About Mechademy**

Mechademy is transforming the predictive analytics landscape for rotating machinery. Our flagship platform, Turbomechanica, seamlessly integrates applied physics with advanced machine learning to deliver prescriptive insights. Turbomechanica detects potential issues long before they become costly failures, enabling clients to maximize uptime, extend asset life, and reduce operational risks. By empowering clients with optimized performance and reliability of their multi-billion-dollar assets, we’re setting a new standard for operational excellence.

**What We’re Looking For**

People who would rather build than talk about building. You’ll fit right in if you:

* Like owning a problem end to end, from the first design note to production.
* Pick up new tools quickly, and have opinions about which ones we should use.
* Care about getting things right, because engineers make real decisions on what we build.
* Enjoy a small, energetic team that ships fast and celebrates its wins.

**Why Mechademy?**

Kickstart your career with a company that’s fun, innovative, and shaping the future of the oil and gas industry. Mechademy is where cutting-edge predictive analytics meets a culture of collaboration and creativity. We’re not your typical start-up company – we thrive on solving complex challenges with technology, fostering growth, and making an impact. Whether you're diving into groundbreaking projects, learning from industry leaders, or enjoying team outings, you’ll feel valued and inspired every step of the way.

•
**Work on groundbreaking technology**
that is shaping the future of rotating equipment diagnostics.

•
**Relish a challenging, dynamic role**
with opportunities for individual contributions that direct impact on the success of the company.

•
**Grow into a leadership position**
as Mechademy grows.

•
**Enjoy flexible work hours**
to work when you are most efficient.

•
**Generous compensation**
to help you achieve financial stability.

At Mechademy, your ideas matter, your growth is our priority, and your future starts now.

**About the Role**

An unplanned trip of a single critical machine can halt production at an entire facility. Turbomechanica exists to see that coming, and the team makes sure the right people see it, trust it and act on it in time. You do not need an industrial or mechanical background. Our domain engineers will teach you how turbines and compressors fail.

**Responsibilities**

* **Platform -**
  Design, build and own features on a secure, multi-tenant platform used by enterprise clients across the globe. Work on authentication, access control and auditability, web and mobile experiences, and APIs that let other systems work with platform data safely.
* **Monitoring -**
  Build the workflows that turn detected issues into alerts, escalations and tracked actions, and the tooling that helps engineers prioritise, investigate and resolve issues faster. Work with large volumes of time series sensor data.
* **Reliability -**
  Add alerting, health checks and dashboards so we catch problems before a client does.
* **Engineering Quality -**
  Write clean, tested code and own features from design through production. Write design notes, take part in design and code reviews, and document what you build.
* **Ways of Working -**
  Ship in two-week sprints using Git, GitHub, CI/CD and ClickUp. Use modern developer tooling, including AI coding assistants, while staying accountable for every line you merge.

**Requirements**

**Must Have**

* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or a related branch
* 1.5+ years building and shipping production software
* Strong Python (preferred), or Java, Go, TypeScript or similar; solid DSA and OOP fundamentals
* REST APIs with Django, FastAPI, Flask, Express or similar
* SQL and relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL
* JavaScript or TypeScript, React preferred
* Web authentication basics (sessions, tokens, OAuth) and secure coding
* Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD
* Clear communication and a real willingness to learn and take feedback
* LLM APIs (Claude and other leading models), Model Context Protocol (MCP), RAG and agent orchestration frameworks

**Good to Have**

* Open source work or side projects you can discuss in depth
* Interest or experience in applied machine learning or LLMs
* Multi-tenant SaaS systems
* Time series data or large datasets
* Mobile app development
* SSO / OIDC providers, role-based access control
* Docker, AWS or Azure in production; logging, monitoring and alerting tools
* Mentoring peers, writing clear design docs

**What This Role Offers**

* **Work that matters -**
  What you build runs in production every day at some of the world’s largest energy companies.
* **Hard, real problems -**
  Security, multi-tenancy, large-scale sensor data and systems engineers depend on.
* **Ownership -**
  A squad buddy gets you productive in 30 days; you own a part of the platform within 6 months.
* **Mentorship -**
  Learn from senior engineers and domain experts with decades of equipment experience.
* **Growth -**
  A clear path from SDE-1 to SDE-2.
* **Flexibility -**
  Flexible work hours and a hybrid setup.

**Selection Process**

1. Introductory call - A short conversation with our talent team about your background, interests and expectations.
2. Technical interview 1 - Problem solving and live coding, plus a deep dive into a project you have shipped.
3. Technical interview 2 - System design and full stack fundamentals: APIs, data modelling, scaling and trade-offs.
4. Hiring manager - A conversation with the P&M Squad Owner about how you work, own problems and grow.
5. HR and culture - Team fit, compensation and joining logistics.

*No trick puzzles. When you apply, tell us about something you have shipped. That matters more to us than where you have worked.*

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**About Brikby**

﻿

Brikby is an AI company that makes instant property ownership verification a possibility. Brikby ingests property documents (any state, language, format and even hand written documents) and provides users with document scrutiny, title flow, missing documentation, red flags and provides BFSI customers with product (loan-type) specific insights. Further, it verifies documents provided by the customer against government records in real time.

Right now we’re working in the BFSI sector and have successfully reduced our customers’ property verification TAT from 4 days to under 30 minutes. Since January, we have processed over 15,000 loan logins. Our plan is to become the gold standard in BFSI and then provide property ownership verification for any use case (B2C, infrastructure, development, telecom, etc.) which requires it.

**What you will work on**

* Work directly with lenders and lawyers to find what slows them down, then design, test and validate the fix with them.
* Turn direct customer metrics into insights that shape what we build next.
* Architect and scale the document ingestion pipeline so every report gets faster and more reliable as volume grows.
* Find out why LLM output goes wrong, fix it at the root, and build evals that keep it fixed.
* Build out our multi agent system and the tools it uses across government sources.
* Ship features end to end in the web app, and run it on GCP with an eye on cost and latency.

**What we are looking for**

* 0 to 5 years of experience building and shipping software. Internships, freelance work and serious side projects all count.
* Strong TypeScript and Node.js, with working knowledge of React, SQL and a cloud platform (GCP preferred).
* Hands on experience with LLM APIs: tool calling, structured output and multi agent orchestration, using agent traces and evals to debug and measure them.
* Experience building backend systems that hold up in production: queues, retries, idempotency, and logs and traces to debug them.
* A habit of measuring: you instrument what you ship and let the data decide what to do next.
* Experience integrating with websites and APIs that were never built for you: sessions, form posts, HTML parsing and rate limits.

**Nice to have**

* Durable workflows and reliable delivery: idempotency keys, the outbox pattern, signed webhooks
* PDF and image processing: OCR and scanned documents
* Reads Hindi, Kannada, Telugu or Tamil
* Exposure to fintech, lending or legal work
* Happy to work from our Gurugram office 5 days a week

description:
**About Us**

Trevolution is a global leader in air ticketing and travel services, serving retail and corporate clients across 50+ markets. With over 20 years of expertise and a strong entrepreneurial mindset, we combine modern technology with a customer-first approach to simplify travel.

Through partnerships with 70+ airlines, we deliver a full booking experience supported by expert service — focused on value, convenience, and reliability. Our portfolio spans online sales, call bookings, and semi-OTAs, and continues to evolve with market trends.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced
**Tech Lead**

You will lead the technical direction of a high-traffic, distributed backend system that sits at the core of our daily business operations. This is a true end-to-end technical ownership role requiring strong engineering judgment, hands-on expertise, and the ability to guide a team through complex, ambiguous problem spaces.

The ideal candidate combines strong Go engineering skills with experience in scalable distributed systems, a pragmatic engineering mindset, and proven leadership capabilities in growing engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end design and delivery of complex backend systems and integrations with downstream services.
* Own the architecture of core backend components, driving decisions around scalability, performance, and maintainability.
* Define and govern integration patterns across multiple services in a distributed microservices environment.
* Ensure performance, reliability, and scalability of high-volume, low-latency systems.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, business analysts, and cross-functional teams to translate requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Mentor and guide engineers; establish best practices in code quality, testing, observability, and security.
* Lead technical decision-making, trade-off analysis, and architectural governance.
* Own production stability, including troubleshooting incidents, performance issues, and system bottlenecks.
* Partner with peer platform teams to align architecture and share engineering standards.

**Required Experience & Skills**

**Experience:**

* 6–12 years of software engineering experience.
* At least 2+ years in a Tech Lead or Principal Engineer role.
* Proven experience leading high-traffic, production-scale backend platforms.
* Experience in the travel domain is a plus.

**Technical Skills:**

* Go (Golang)/ Node.js: Strong proficiency required, including concurrency, memory management, and idiomatic patterns.
* Databases: Strong experience with at least one at scale (MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB).
* Redis: caching strategies, streams, and key/value design patterns.
* Elasticsearch: search and analytics use cases.
* Microservices & APIs: REST, JSON, service design, and integration contracts.
* Security: OAuth, JWT, API security best practices.
* Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, Sentry, distributed tracing.
* Containers & CI/CD: Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI (or similar).
* Cloud: AWS, GCP, or Azure experience.
* Event-driven architecture: Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging systems.
* Testing: strong discipline in unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* Experience with AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar tools) and using AI agents to improve engineering productivity.

There is no one-size-fits-all here; we are quite flexible and use an individual approach with every candidate we meet. While getting familiar during our interview, we try to understand where your working experience, professional skills, and future contribution to the company can be applied within our multiple business projects.

**With us, you will**

* Be part of a top-tier team of professionals working on global products used by millions of customers worldwide.
* Build and scale complex, in-house solutions that power real business impact.
* Learn and grow through internal lectures, workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions led by colleagues and team leads.
* Benefit from comprehensive insurance coverage.
* Enjoy convenient parking options.
